It focuses on fostering innovation in agriculture and allied sectors by providing grants to early-stage startups developing solutions in areas such as crop science, animal husbandry, fisheries, and natural resource management. The scheme is implemented by ICAR under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare and targets entrepreneurs and startups engaged in agri-based innovations. It forms part of ICAR’s broader mandate to promote agricultural entrepreneurship and technology transfer.
target_beneficiaries: agri-startups; startups; entrepreneurs
eligibility: Startups incorporated in India, working in the domain of agriculture and allied sectors, with innovative ideas or prototypes in areas such as crop improvement, animal husbandry, fisheries, natural resource management, or agri-processing. The startup must be recognized by DPIIT or recommended by an ICAR institute, and should not have received more than a specified limit of funding from other government sources. Preference is given to startups led by women, SC/ST, or those working in aspirational districts.
benefits: Financial support for prototype development, field testing, and scaling; access to ICAR’s research facilities, laboratories, and expert mentorship; opportunity to collaborate with ICAR scientists and KVKs for validation; assistance in intellectual property rights (IPR) filing and technology commercialization; networking with investors, incubators, and agri-industry partners; visibility through ICAR’s platforms and events.
financial_support: The scheme provides grant-based financial support to selected agri-startups for activities such as prototype development, field trials, and market validation. The quantum of support is determined based on the project proposal and stage of innovation, with disbursement made in milestones upon achievement of predefined deliverables. Funds are released directly to the startup’s account after due appraisal and approval by the ICAR screening committee.
application_process: 1. Visit the official ICAR website or designated portal for agri-startup grants. 2. Check eligibility and ensure the startup is DPIIT-recognized or endorsed by an ICAR institute. 3. Prepare a detailed project proposal including innovation description, objectives, methodology, budget, and expected outcomes. 4. Submit the application online along with required documents. 5. Applications are screened by an ICAR committee for technical feasibility and innovation quotient. 6. Shortlisted startups may be invited for a presentation or interview. 7. Final selection is made based on merit, and approved grantees receive a sanction letter. 8. Funds are disbursed in installments as per milestones. 9. Grantees are required to submit progress reports and utilization certificates.
implementing_agency: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

overview: The Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP) by NITI Aayog is a unified access portal that aggregates government schemes, mentorship, incubators, accelerators, and financial resources to support women entrepreneurs across India. It serves as a one-stop information hub connecting women-led ventures with over 300+ resources, 944+ mentors, 835+ government initiatives, and 576+ incubators & accelerators. WEP enables registration, profile completion, mentorship matching, and access to curated schemes and partner networks to foster entrepreneurial growth.
target_beneficiaries: women entrepreneurs
eligibility: Women entrepreneurs in India seeking to start, grow, or scale their ventures can register on the platform. No specific eligibility criteria are mentioned for platform access; registration requires OTP verification and profile completion to access full resources.
benefits: Access to over 300+ resources including government schemes, mentorship from 944+ experts, 835+ government initiatives, 576+ incubators & accelerators, networking with 112,832+ WEP family members, personalized partner recommendations via Smart Match, mentorship guidance, financial inclusion support, skill development through articles and videos, workshop participation, and recognition through WEP awards and outreach programs.
financial_support: WEP does not directly provide financial support but facilitates access to financial resources, grants, and schemes tailored for women-led businesses through its 'Access to Finance' section, which curates funding opportunities from government initiatives, financial institutions, and partner organizations.
application_process: 1. Visit the WEP portal at wep.gov.in 2. Click 'Register' or 'Start your entrepreneurial journey' 3. Enter OTP for verification 4. Complete registration and set a new password 5. Complete your profile after registration 6. Use Smart Match to get personalized partner recommendations 7. Explore mentors, government initiatives, incubators, accelerators, and schemes 8. Access financial resources via the 'Access to Finance' section 9. Join workshops, view articles and videos for skill development 10. Engage with the WEP community and partners for networking and support
deadlines: Rolling basis
implementing_agency: NITI Aayog

scheme_name: Mudra Shishu Loans for Women (Under PMMY)
overview: Mudra Shishu Loans for Women (Under PMMY) is a component of the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) launched on April 8, 2015, providing loans up to ₹50,000 to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises, with a focus on women entrepreneurs. The scheme operates through a refinancing model where MUDRA extends refinance support to Banks, NBFCs, and MFIs, which in turn lend to beneficiaries. It aims to promote inclusive and sustainable entrepreneurial culture, particularly among women and weaker sections of society.
target_beneficiaries: women entrepreneurs; micro enterprises; small businesses; non-corporate entities
eligibility: Any Indian Citizen who has a business plan for a non-farm income generating activity such as manufacturing, processing, trading or service sector whose credit need is up to 20 lakh can approach either a Bank, MFI or NBFC for availing of MUDRA loans under PMMY. The usual terms and conditions of the lending agency may have to be followed for availing of loans under PMMY.
benefits: Access to collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh under PMMY (with Shishu category covering up to ₹50,000), availability through Banks, NBFCs, and MFIs, online application via Udyamimitra portal, no agents or middlemen engaged by MUDRA, interest subvention schemes for specific categories (e.g., 2% for Shishu loans under Aatmanirbhar Bharat Package), and support for income-generating activities in manufacturing, processing, trading, service, and agri-allied sectors.
financial_support: MUDRA provides refinance support to Banks/NBFCs/MFIs for lending to micro units having loan requirements up to ₹20 lakh. The refinance is available for term loan and working capital loan up to an amount of ₹20 lakh per unit. MUDRA does not exceeding the sanctioned limit. The eligible Banks/NBFCs/MFIs, who comply with the requirements as notified, can avail refinance from MUDRA for the loans given by them for eligible MUDRA compliant activities under Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus categories.
application_process: 1. Approach any of the lending institutions (Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, MFIs, NBFCs) mentioned above. 2. Alternatively, apply online through the Udyamimitra portal (www.udyamimitra.in). 3. Submit the required documents as per the lending institution's guidelines. 4. Await approval and disbursement from the lending institution.
deadlines: Rolling basis
implementing_agency: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd. (MUDRA)

scheme_name: TIDCO – Tamil Nadu Industrial Dev. Corp Schemes
overview: TIDCO (Tamil Nadu Industrial Development Corporation Limited) is a premier industrial development agency of the Government of Tamil Nadu, established in 1965. It promotes medium and large industries through joint ventures and serves as the nodal agency for industrial corridor projects in Tamil Nadu. TIDCO facilitates investment in large industrial and infrastructure projects, promotes four types of joint ventures, and is registered with the RBI as a Non-Banking Financial Company.
target_beneficiaries: medium and large industries; joint venture partners; infrastructure developers
eligibility: Entities interested in joint sector (equity participation above 11% and up to 50%), associate sector (equity participation above 2% and up to 11%), escort sector (1% equity), or escort services (no equity participation) with TIDCO for industrial development in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Access to TIDCO's network of joint venture projects across sectors including Chemicals, Fertilizers, Pharmaceuticals, Textiles, Iron and Steel, Auto Components, Food & Agro, Floriculture, Engineering, Petroleum and Petrochemicals, infrastructure projects like IT/ITES Parks, Bio-Tech Parks, SEZs, Road Development Projects, and Agri Export Zones. TIDCO facilitates investment in large industrial and infrastructure projects in Tamil Nadu and promotes balanced industrial growth.
financial_support: TIDCO promotes joint ventures with equity participation ranging from 1% to 50% depending on the sector type. Financial support is structured through equity participation in joint venture projects, with TIDCO acting as a nodal agency for industrial corridor projects and facilitating large-scale investments.
application_process: 1. Identify suitable joint venture opportunity with TIDCO 2. Determine equity participation category (Joint Sector: >11% to 50%, Associate Sector: >2% to 11%, Escort Sector: 1% equity, Escort Services: no equity) 3. Submit proposal for joint venture project 4. Undergo evaluation by TIDCO 5. Execute joint venture agreement upon approval
deadlines: Rolling basis
implementing_agency: Tamil Nadu Industrial Development Corporation Limited (TIDCO)

overview: Startup Karnataka Policy 2022-27 is a state-level initiative by the Government of Karnataka to foster a vibrant startup ecosystem by providing financial support, infrastructure, mentorship, and regulatory facilitation to startups across various sectors. The policy aims to position Karnataka as a global innovation hub by supporting early-stage and growth-stage startups through grants, incubation, and access to funding networks.
target_beneficiaries: startups; women entrepreneurs; SC/ST entrepreneurs; differently abled entrepreneurs; rural startups; agri-startups
eligibility: Startups incorporated in Karnataka as a Private Limited Company, LLP, or Partnership Firm under the Companies Act, 2013 or LLP Act, 2008, with operations primarily in Karnataka, working on innovative products, services, or processes, and recognized by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) or recommended by a recognized incubator in Karnataka.
benefits: Financial support in the form of grants, seed funding, and reimbursement of costs for patent filing, ISO certification, and participation in national/international events; access to incubation centers, mentorship, networking events, and investor connect programs; facilitation in obtaining regulatory approvals and clearances; priority in government procurement; and support for international market expansion through trade shows and delegations.
financial_support: The policy provides financial assistance through various mechanisms including grants up to INR 50 lakhs for product development, reimbursement of up to INR 2 lakhs for patent filing, INR 1 lakh for ISO certification, and INR 1 lakh for participation in national/international events. Seed funding is also provided through the Karnataka Startup Seed Fund (KSSF) managed by KATS, with investments up to INR 50 lakhs per startup.
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to INR 50 lakhs per startup for product development and innovation support
application_process: 1. Register on the Startup Karnataka portal (startup.karnataka.gov.in) 2. Create a profile and provide details about the startup 3. Apply for specific schemes under the policy such as innovation grant, patent reimbursement, or seed fund 4. Upload required documents including incorporation certificate, DPIIT recognition, project report, and bank details 5. Submit the application for review by the Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society (KATS) 6. Await evaluation and approval, post which funds are disbursed in stages based on milestones
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year subject to availability of funds
implementing_agency: Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society (KATS), under the Department of Electronics, IT, BT and S&T, Government of Karnataka

overview: TANSIDCO (Tamil Nadu Small Industries Development Corporation Limited) provides industrial infrastructure support through the allotment of plots, sheds, and plug-and-play modules on outright sale, lease, or rental basis across Tamil Nadu. The scheme facilitates MSMEs and entrepreneurs by offering developed industrial spaces with basic amenities in various industrial estates. It aims to promote industrial growth by making land and built-up spaces accessible for manufacturing and service units.
target_beneficiaries: MSME; entrepreneurs; manufacturing units; service units
eligibility: Any individual, entrepreneur, MSME, or industrial unit seeking to establish or expand operations in Tamil Nadu can apply for allotment of plots, sheds, or modules. Applicants must visit the industrial estate physically and upload geo-tagged photos as part of the application. Udyam/UAM registration is encouraged but not explicitly mandatory for application initiation.
benefits: Access to developed industrial plots, sheds, and plug-and-play modules with basic infrastructure (power, water, approach roads). Options for outright purchase, 99-year lease, or rental basis. Transparent allotment process with GIS mapping, online application, and status tracking. Dedicated facilities like Silver Anklet Manufacturing Complex in Salem. Support for backward block industrial estates.
financial_support: Financial support is indirect through subsidized or market-linked allotment of industrial infrastructure. Costs vary by location, extent, and type (plot/shed/module). Examples include Plug & Play modules in Guindy ranging from Rs. 69,05,600 to Rs. 1,34,44,340 and in Ambattur from Rs. 74,88,300 to Rs. 1,49,90,340. Outright sale basis plots are available across districts (e.g., Ariyalur: Rs. 4,69,780 to Rs. 18,69,018; Chengalpattu Alathur Phase-II: up to Rs. 3,72,44,782). No direct grants or loans are provided; applicants bear the cost of allotment.
application_process: 1. Visit the TANSIDCO website and navigate to the vacancy details for plots/sheds/modules. 2. Select the desired industrial estate and property type (outright sale, lease, rental, plug-and-play). 3. Physically visit the industrial estate for verification. 4. Upload geo-tagged photos of the proposed plot/shed/module. 5. Fill out the online application form with plot/shed/module details. 6. Submit the application and proceed to payment via SBI Collect or other modes. 7. Track application status using the application number. 8. Upon approval, proceed with allotment documentation and possession.
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted year-round based on vacancy availability.
implementing_agency: Tamil Nadu Small Industries Development Corporation Limited (TANSIDCO)

overview: The Elevate 100 Programme is a flagship initiative by the Government of Karnataka aimed at identifying, nurturing, and scaling high-potential startups across the state. It provides selected startups with financial support, mentorship, market access, and networking opportunities to foster innovation and entrepreneurship. The programme focuses on early-stage and growth-stage startups with scalable business models and aims to position Karnataka as a leading startup destination in India.
target_beneficiaries: startups
eligibility: Startups must be registered in Karnataka under the Companies Act, 2013, LLP Act, 2008, or as a partnership firm. The startup should have been incorporated not more than 5 years ago from the date of application. It must be working on an innovative product, service, or process with potential for scalability and job creation. The startup should not have received more than INR 50 Lakhs in funding from any government scheme prior to applying. At least one founder must be a resident of Karnataka.
benefits: Selected startups receive a grant of up to INR 50 Lakhs for product development and market expansion. They gain access to mentorship from industry leaders, participation in bootcamps and workshops, and opportunities to showcase their solutions at national and international events. The programme facilitates connections with potential investors, corporates, and government bodies. Startups also receive incubation support, legal and accounting assistance, and access to prototyping and testing facilities. Additionally, they are featured in the Elevate 100 compendium and gain visibility through media and promotional campaigns.
financial_support: The programme provides a one-time grant of up to INR 50 Lakhs per selected startup. The grant is disbursed in tranches based on milestone achievement and is intended for product development, technology acquisition, market expansion, and team building. There is no equity dilution or repayment obligation. The funds are released by the Department of IT, BT and S&T, Government of Karnataka.
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to INR 50 Lakhs
application_process: 1. Visit the official Elevate Karnataka portal at https://elevate.karnataka.gov.in. 2. Register on the portal by providing basic details of the startup and founders. 3. Log in and fill out the online application form with information about the startup, innovation, business model, traction, and team. 4. Upload required documents including Certificate of Incorporation, PAN, pitch deck, and founder details. 5. Submit the application before the deadline. 6. Applications are screened by an expert committee based on innovation, scalability, team strength, and potential impact. 7. Shortlisted startups are invited for a pitch presentation or interview. 8. Final selection is made by the apex committee, and results are communicated via email and the portal.
deadlines: Applications are invited annually; the exact dates vary each year. Interested startups are advised to monitor the official portal for announcements regarding the application window.
implementing_agency: Department of Information Technology, Biotechnology and Science and Technology (IT, BT and S&T), Government of Karnataka

overview: The Synd Mahila Shakti Scheme is a loan product offered by Syndicate Bank (now merged with Canara Bank) specifically designed to support women entrepreneurs. It provides financial assistance to women for starting or expanding business ventures, with a focus on promoting women's economic empowerment and entrepreneurship. The scheme is part of the bank's priority sector lending initiatives aimed at fostering inclusive growth.
target_beneficiaries: women entrepreneurs
eligibility: The scheme is available to women entrepreneurs who are Indian citizens and wish to start or expand a business venture. Applicants must be sole proprietors, partners in a partnership firm, or directors of a private limited company where women hold majority stake. The business activity should be viable and fall under permissible sectors as per bank guidelines.
benefits: Financial support for business setup, expansion, or working capital needs; concessional interest rates compared to standard loans; simplified documentation process; quick loan approval and disbursal; no collateral requirement for loans up to a certain limit (as per bank's policy); and support for various business activities including manufacturing, services, and trading.
financial_support: The scheme provides term loans and working capital finance to women entrepreneurs. The loan amount, interest rate, and repayment tenure are determined based on the project cost, viability, and borrower's repayment capacity. Specific quantum and terms are assessed on a case-by-case basis by the bank.
application_process: 1. Visit the nearest Canara Bank branch (formerly Syndicate Bank) or access the bank's online portal. 2. Obtain and fill out the loan application form for the Synd Mahila Shakti Scheme. 3. Submit the completed application along with required documents. 4. Bank officials will verify the documents and assess the project viability. 5. Upon approval, the loan amount will be sanctioned and disbursed as per the agreed terms.
deadlines: Rolling basis
implementing_agency: Canara Bank

overview: Vizag Fintech Valley is a state-level initiative in Andhra Pradesh aimed at establishing Visakhapatnam as a leading fintech hub by fostering innovation, supporting fintech startups, and creating a conducive ecosystem for financial technology development through infrastructure, mentorship, and industry collaboration.
target_beneficiaries: fintech startups; entrepreneurs; MSMEs in fintech
eligibility: Fintech startups and companies operating in financial technology domains such as digital payments, lending, blockchain, insurtech, regtech, and wealthtech that are registered entities and willing to operate from or establish presence in Visakhapatnam.
benefits: Access to plug-and-play office infrastructure, high-speed internet, mentorship from industry experts, networking opportunities with investors and corporates, regulatory guidance, participation in fintech events and hackathons, and support for proof-of-concept development.
financial_support: The scheme provides non-financial support primarily; direct financial grants or subsidies are not explicitly mentioned in the evidence. Support is focused on infrastructure, mentorship, and ecosystem enablement rather than capital infusion.
application_process: 1. Visit the official Vizag Fintech Valley website at https://fintechvalley.in 2. Navigate to the 'Apply' or 'Join Us' section 3. Fill out the online application form with company and founder details 4. Submit information about the fintech product or service 5. Await review by the selection committee 6. If shortlisted, attend an interview or pitch session 7. Receive approval and onboarding instructions for workspace and resources.
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year.
implementing_agency: Government of Andhra Pradesh in collaboration with industry partners and academic institutions
contact_details: Email: info@fintechvalley.in | Phone: +91-891-250XXXX (as per website contact section)

overview: The AP Startup Policy & Innovation is a state-level initiative by the Government of Andhra Pradesh aimed at fostering a vibrant startup ecosystem through financial support, infrastructure, mentorship, and regulatory facilitation. It focuses on promoting innovation, entrepreneurship, and job creation across key sectors such as IT, biotechnology, agriculture, and manufacturing. The policy provides a comprehensive framework for startups at various stages, from ideation to scaling, with dedicated funds and incubation support.
target_beneficiaries: startups; early-stage ventures; women entrepreneurs; SC/ST entrepreneurs; differently abled entrepreneurs; agri-startups; tech startups
eligibility: The applicant must be a startup registered in Andhra Pradesh as a Private Limited Company, Limited Liability Partnership (LLP), or Registered Partnership Firm. The startup should be incorporated not more than 7 years ago from the date of application. It must be working towards innovation, development, deployment, or commercialization of new products, processes, or services driven by technology or intellectual property. The turnover of the entity should not exceed INR 25 Crores in any of the previous financial years. At least 51% of the shareholding should be held by Indian promoters or residents. Startups must be recommended by a recognized incubator or approved by the State Level Committee.
benefits: Financial support in the form of grants, seed funding, and reimbursement of costs; access to state-of-the-art incubation infrastructure with subsidized rentals; mentorship and guidance from industry experts and successful entrepreneurs; facilitation of intellectual property rights (IPR) filing with fee reimbursement; assistance in obtaining certifications and regulatory approvals; networking opportunities with investors, corporates, and academia; participation in national and international startup events; fast-track clearance for land, power, and other statutory approvals; and support for market access and pilot projects.
financial_support: The policy provides financial assistance through multiple channels: a seed grant of up to INR 10 Lakhs for early-stage startups for prototype development and market validation; reimbursement of up to 50% of costs incurred on patent filing, subject to a maximum of INR 2 Lakhs per Indian patent and INR 5 Lakhs per international patent; 100% reimbursement of fees paid for ISO, CE, HACCP, and other international certifications, up to INR 1 Lakh; and a monthly operational support of INR 10,000 per seat for startups housed in approved incubation centers for a maximum period of 12 months. Additionally, a venture fund of INR 200 Crores has been created to provide follow-on funding through equity or debt instruments.
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to INR 10 Lakhs as seed grant; up to INR 2 Lakhs for Indian patent and INR 5 Lakhs for international patent reimbursement; up to INR 1 Lakh for certification reimbursement; INR 10,000 per seat per month for incubation support (max 12 months)
application_process: 1. Register the startup on the official AP Innovation Portal (https://apinnovation.ap.gov.in). 2. Log in and fill out the online application form for the AP Startup Policy & Innovation benefits. 3. Upload the required documents including Certificate of Incorporation, PAN, GST details, pitch deck, and details of innovation. 4. Obtain a recommendation letter from a recognized incubation center in Andhra Pradesh. 5. Submit the completed application online. 6. The application is scrutinized by the State Level Committee. 7. Upon approval, the startup receives an approval letter and can proceed to claim benefits. 8. For financial claims, submit bills and vouchers along with utilization reports to the implementing agency for reimbursement or disbursement.
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year subject to availability of funds.
implementing_agency: Andhra Pradesh Innovation Society (APIS), under the Information Technology, Electronics & Communications Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh

scheme_name: ICMR Research Grants for Health Startups
overview: The ICMR Research Grants for Health Startups is a funding initiative by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) aimed at supporting health-related startups through financial assistance for research and innovation in biomedical and public health domains. The scheme operates under ICMR's extramural and intramural research programmes, providing grants to eligible entities for conducting research aligned with national health priorities. It encourages innovation in areas such as diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, and health technologies, with a focus on translating research into practical healthcare solutions.
target_beneficiaries: startups; health startups; biomedical startups; MSME; research institutions
eligibility: Indian research institutes or organisations can submit the EoI, provided they fulfil the following criteria: a research team of an institute with cutting-edge biomedical research experience, led by a senior PI; excellent track record in health research in terms of impactful publications; demonstrated collaboration with or contribution to ICMR; willingness to contribute to ICMR’s objectives and activities on an honorary basis (e.g., adjunct faculty for capacity development, assisting with proposal development workshops); willingness to work with ICMR on national priorities related to public health; categories of research teams: basic research, translational research, clinical research, laboratory-based research, population-based research.
benefits: Recognition as ICMR Collaborating Centre of Excellence (ICMR-CCoE), access to ICMR's research infrastructure, mentorship from ICMR scientists, opportunities for collaboration on national health projects, visibility in national research networks, and support for proposal development and technical guidance through ICMR's portals and helpdesks such as MedTech Mitra, Patent Mitra, and Biostatistics Helpline.
financial_support: No Financial Support: Recognition as ICMR-CCoE is independent of any financial support being given to the institution by ICMR. No special financial support will be provided to ICMR -CCoE.
application_process: 1. Submission portal will open from 1st July 2026. 2. Visit https://epms.icmr.org.in. The user manual (under Guidelines → e-PMS manual) is available on the portal. 3. The proposal submission process has three steps: o Step 1: PI registration/login https://epms.icmr.org.in/userLogin o Step 2: Verify email ID and complete/update PI profile o Step 3: Proposal submission 4. After completing the mandatory sections of the PI profile: o Go to Proposal Submission o Click on Apply Proposal o Select ‘Request for Expression of Interest for ICMR Collaborating Centre of Excellence (ICMR-CCoE) – 2026’ from the dropdown – Apply New Proposal o Fill the form step by step. 5. For queries, contact: po.epms@icmr.gov.in
deadlines: Release of Call July 01, 2026; Last date of Submission of proposal July 31, 2026 (17:00 hrs); Declaration of Result September 15, 2026
implementing_agency: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)

overview: iHub Gujarat – Technology Innovation Fund is a state-level initiative under the Government of Gujarat aimed at fostering technology-driven innovation and entrepreneurship. The scheme provides financial and non-financial support to startups and innovators through a dedicated innovation fund. It focuses on scaling early-stage ventures with high growth potential in technology sectors. The program is managed by iHub Ahmedabad, a Section 8 company promoted by the Government of Gujarat.
target_beneficiaries: startups; technology innovators; early-stage ventures
eligibility: Startups and technology innovators registered in Gujarat with a minimum viable product (MVP) or prototype, working in sectors such as AI, IoT, biotech, agritech, cleantech, or deep tech. Applicants must be incorporated as a private limited company, LLP, or partnership firm under Indian laws, and demonstrate potential for scalability and social impact.
benefits: Financial grants for product development and market access, mentorship from industry experts, access to prototyping and lab facilities, networking opportunities with investors and corporates, regulatory guidance, and support for intellectual property rights (IPR) filing.
financial_support: The scheme provides grant-based financial support of up to INR 25 lakhs per eligible startup for technology development, prototype scaling, and market validation. Funds are disbursed in tranches based on milestone achievement and are non-repayable.
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to INR 25 Lakhs
application_process: 1. Visit the iHub Ahmedabad official website and register as an applicant. 2. Fill out the online application form with details of the startup, innovation, and team. 3. Upload required documents including incorporation certificate, PAN, product description, and prototype details. 4. Submit the application for preliminary screening. 5. Shortlisted applicants are invited for a pitch presentation before the selection committee. 6. Final selection is based on innovation, scalability, team strength, and potential impact. 7. Approved applicants receive a grant sanction letter and undergo due diligence before fund disbursement.
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year subject to availability of funds.
implementing_agency: iHub Ahmedabad (a Section 8 company promoted by the Government of Gujarat)

scheme_name: MahaDBT – Direct Benefit Transfer for Entrepreneurs
overview: MahaDBT – Direct Benefit Transfer for Entrepreneurs is a state-level scheme in Maharashtra that facilitates the direct transfer of financial benefits to eligible entrepreneurs through the MahaDBT portal. The scheme aims to streamline the disbursement of subsidies, grants, and other financial assistance by linking beneficiary bank accounts with Aadhaar for transparent and efficient delivery. It supports various entrepreneur-focused initiatives under departments like Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship, and others, ensuring timely and traceable benefit transfers.
target_beneficiaries: entrepreneurs; MSME; startups; women entrepreneurs; SC/ST; OBC; VJNT; SBC
eligibility: Eligibility varies by specific sub-scheme under MahaDBT, but generally requires applicants to be residents of Maharashtra, possess valid domicile and caste/income certificates where applicable, have an Aadhaar-seeded bank account, and meet the specific criteria of the benefit scheme they are applying for (e.g., income limits, educational qualifications, category-based reservations). For entrepreneur-focused schemes, applicants must be engaged in or planning to start a business venture and may need to provide project reports, registration documents, and proof of training or skill acquisition.
benefits: Benefits include direct financial transfers to bank accounts, reimbursement of tuition and exam fees, maintenance allowances, stipends for training (e.g., Rs. 500/month for ITI trainees), scholarships for professional and higher education, fee waivers, and support for skill development and entrepreneurship. Non-financial benefits include real-time application tracking, digital locker integration, grievance redressal, and access to citizen charter and helpline support.
financial_support: Financial support is transferred directly to the beneficiary’s Aadhaar-seeded bank account via the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism. The amount and type of support depend on the specific sub-scheme (e.g., maintenance allowance, stipend, fee reimbursement, or scholarship). Payments are made in real time or monthly, as per the scheme guidelines, and beneficiaries can track disbursement status through the MahaDBT portal.
application_process: 1. Visit the MahaDBT portal at https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in. 2. Register as a new applicant using mobile number, Aadhaar, PAN, and scholarship/application ID if applicable. 3. Log in to the portal using credentials. 4. Browse or search for eligible schemes under departments like Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship, or others. 5. Select the desired scheme and click 'Apply'. 6. Fill in the application form with personal, educational, and financial details. 7. Upload required documents such as domicile, caste, income, educational certificates, and Aadhaar. 8. Submit the application and note the application ID. 9. Track application status in real time via the portal. 10. Upon approval, benefits are transferred directly to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
deadlines: Application acceptance for the new academic year A.Y. 2025–26 has commenced from 30th June 2025. Application acceptance (Fresh/Renewal) for A.Y. 2025–26 will continue until 30th June 2026. The Re-apply provision for A.Y. 2023–24 and A.Y. 2024–25 will continue until 30th June 2026.
implementing_agency: Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Department, Government of Maharashtra
contact_details: Helpline Number: 022-49150800 | Chief Minister Helpline: 24x7 (Toll Free) No.: 1800 120 8040

overview: T-Works Prototype Manufacturing Hub is a state-level initiative by the Government of Telangana to support innovators, startups, and MSMEs in transforming ideas into tangible prototypes through access to advanced manufacturing facilities, technical expertise, and collaborative workspaces. It aims to reduce the time and cost of product development by providing end-to-end prototyping support across multiple domains including electronics, mechanical, IoT, and bio-fabrication. The hub fosters innovation by enabling rapid iteration and validation of concepts before scaling to production.
target_beneficiaries: startups; MSME; innovators; entrepreneurs
eligibility: Open to individuals, startups, MSMEs, research institutions, and innovators based in Telangana who have a product idea or concept requiring prototyping support. Priority is given to those working on socially relevant, industrially viable, or technologically innovative solutions.
benefits: Access to state-of-the-art prototyping equipment (3D printers, CNC machines, PCB labs, etc.), technical support from expert engineers, design and simulation tools, material assistance, workspace for fabrication, and guidance on design for manufacturability. Users can iterate rapidly and test functionality before moving to production.
financial_support: T-Works offers subsidized access to its facilities and services, with pricing structured to be affordable for early-stage innovators. While specific financial subsidies or waivers are not detailed in the evidence, the hub provides cost-effective prototyping solutions compared to market rates, enabling reduced R&D expenditure.
application_process: 1. Visit the T-Works website at https://t-works.telangana.gov.in 2. Explore available facilities and services based on your prototyping needs 3. Submit an inquiry or application through the online portal detailing your project requirements 4. Await review by the T-Works team 5. Upon approval, schedule access to facilities and begin prototyping with technical support 6. Iterate and refine your prototype as needed 7. Complete the project and collect your final prototype.
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year based on facility availability.
implementing_agency: Government of Telangana, implemented by T-Works (a initiative under the Department of Industries and Commerce, Telangana)

overview: The UP Textile Park Scheme is a state-level initiative by the Uttar Pradesh government to promote textile industry development by establishing integrated textile parks with modern infrastructure and facilities. The scheme aims to attract investment, generate employment, and enhance the competitiveness of the textile sector in Uttar Pradesh through cluster-based development.
target_beneficiaries: MSME; textile manufacturers; entrepreneurs; industrial units
eligibility: Textile manufacturing units, MSMEs, and entrepreneurs engaged in spinning, weaving, processing, garmenting, or technical textiles who wish to set up operations in UP Textile Parks. Applicants must comply with land use norms, environmental regulations, and possess necessary statutory clearances as per Uttar Pradesh industrial policies.
benefits: Allotment of developed land or built-up space in textile parks at concessional rates, access to plug-and-play infrastructure (power, water, drainage, effluent treatment), common facilities like testing labs, design centers, logistics support, and skill development centers. Financial incentives including capital subsidy, interest subsidy, and power tariff concessions as per UP Textile Policy 2017-2022.
financial_support: Financial support includes capital subsidy up to 30% of fixed capital investment (max INR 5 Crore), interest subsidy of 5% on term loans for 5 years, and power tariff concession of INR 1 per unit for 5 years. Assistance is disbursed through nodal agencies after verification of investment and employment generation.
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to INR 5 Crore
application_process: 1. Identify suitable textile park and plot/unit requirement 2. Submit application to Uttar Pradesh State Industrial Development Corporation (UPSIDC) or concerned development authority 3. Provide project report, land use details, and financial appraisal 4. Obtain in-principle approval from the committee 5. Execute lease agreement and pay initial deposit 6. Commence construction/installation as per approved plan 7. Apply for financial incentives post-commencement of production
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications accepted throughout the year subject to plot availability
implementing_agency: Uttar Pradesh State Industrial Development Corporation (UPSIDC)

overview: MIDC Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation is the premier industrial infrastructure development agency of the Government of Maharashtra, established in 1962 under the M.I.D.C. Act, 1961. It plays a pivotal role in Maharashtra's industrial and economic growth by providing world-class industrial infrastructure, formulating equitable economic development policies, and supporting industries throughout their investment lifecycle. MIDC has built 300 industrial areas covering approximately 101,171.41 hectares of land and developed specialized parks for sectors including IT, BT, SEZs, Wine (Grape Processing), Silver Zone, and Gems.
target_beneficiaries: industries; entrepreneurs; MSME; investors
eligibility: Eligibility varies by specific scheme or policy; general eligibility for land allotment includes submission of Detailed Project Report (DPR), Constitution of the Applicant, Block Plan, and other applicable documents. For MSME incentives, refer to Industrial Policy 2019 and Package Scheme of Incentives 2019 which classify talukas into categories A, B, C, D, D+ based on industrial development level, with eligibility based on ownership, size, employment, and sector.
benefits: Benefits include access to developed industrial plots with infrastructure (roads, water supply, drainage, streetlights), single window clearance for industrial approvals, online payment systems, investor helpdesk, land allotment via direct or e-bidding process, issuance of offer and allotment letters, execution of lease agreement, plot possession, building plan approval via BPAMS portal, and occupancy certificate. Non-financial benefits include ease of doing business, proactive investor grievance redressal through MAITRI, and industry-friendly policies. Financial benefits may include fiscal incentives under state policies like Package Scheme of Incentives 2019, though specific amounts depend on the policy and location.
financial_support: MIDC provides land on lease basis (typically 99 years) with associated charges: processing fee (based on area), application advance (5% Earnest Money Deposit calculated as prevailing industrial premium rate per sq.m. × area required × 5%), and balance occupancy premium (BOP) payable within 30 days of allotment letter (extendable up to 150 days with delayed payment charges). Financial support for industries is primarily through state government policies (e.g., Package Scheme of Incentives 2019) offering fiscal incentives like tax exemptions, subsidies, and concessions, which MIDC facilitates but does not directly provide as loans or grants.
application_process: 1. Fill Up & Submit Application for land allotment via 'Direct' or 'e-Bidding' process. 2. Pay Processing Fee (based on area) and Application Advance (5% EMD) online via NEFT/RTGS/Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI. 3. Application processed by Land Allotment Committee (LAC); IT park applications processed by head office. 4. LAC meeting held after DPR scrutiny; decision is final; approved minutes published on MIDC website. 5. System generated Offer Letter issued upon LAC approval; applicant must pay 25% EMD (Direct) or 20% EMD (e-Bidding H1 bidder) within 15 days. 6. System generated Allotment Letter issued upon EMD payment; applicant must pay Balance Occupancy Premium (BOP) within 30 days (extendable up to 150 days). 7. Execute Agreement to Lease (A to L) after BOP payment, pay necessary stamp duty. 8. MIDC deputes surveyor for plot handover/takeover document signing. 9. Submit building plan with details to BPAMS portal via appointed Architect; Special Planning Authority scrutinizes plan; challan generated; after payment, commencement certificate issued within 35 days. 10. Complete construction and commence production within specified time period (A/B Zone: 3 years, C Zone: 5 years, D/D+ Zone: 7 years from actual possession). 11. Apply online via SWC portal for Occupancy Certificate after site inspection by SPA (if required). 12. Execute final lease upon receipt of Occupancy Certificate.
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications accepted year-round for Direct and e-Bidding allotment.
implementing_agency: Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation (MIDC)
contact_details: Email: ceo@midcindia.org | Phone: 022-45758671/45758643 (Express Tower), 022-40160800/47489237 (Andheri) | Emergency Contact: 022-47484679/022-47484699

overview: The Rajasthan Investment Promotion Scheme (RIPS) is a state-level initiative by the Government of Rajasthan to promote industrial investment and economic development in the state. It offers financial incentives and concessions to eligible industrial units for setting up new enterprises or expanding existing ones. The scheme aims to generate employment, boost exports, and promote balanced regional development across Rajasthan.
target_beneficiaries: MSME; large industries; manufacturing units; service enterprises; tourism units
eligibility: Eligible units include new industrial units setting up operations in Rajasthan or existing units undertaking substantial expansion. The unit must be engaged in manufacturing, services, or tourism as specified in the scheme guidelines. Investment must be made in plant and machinery, and the unit must commence commercial production within the stipulated time frame. Units must be registered under relevant statutes and obtain all necessary clearances.
benefits: Benefits under RIPS include exemption from electricity duty, stamp duty, land conversion charges, and entry tax on capital goods. Financial incentives consist of interest subsidy, employment generation subsidy, and capital subsidy. Additional benefits include reimbursement of VAT/CST, payroll tax subsidy, and special packages for mega projects and thrust sectors.
financial_support: Financial support under RIPS includes interest subsidy on term loans (up to 5-7% depending on zone and unit size), employment generation subsidy (₹15,000-₹25,000 per employee per year), and capital subsidy (up to 30-50% of investment in plant and machinery for eligible sectors). The quantum and rate of subsidy vary based on the zone classification of Rajasthan), investment size, and employment generated. Disbursement is made post-verification of claims and compliance with scheme conditions.
application_process: 1. Submit application online through the Rajasthan Single Sign-On (RajSSO) portal or designated nodal agency. 2. Upload required documents including project report, investment details, and clearance certificates. 3. Application is scrutinized by the District Level Committee (DLC) or State Level Committee (SLC) based on investment scale. 4. Upon approval, letter of intent or eligibility certificate is issued. 5. After commencement of commercial production, submit claims for subsidies with supporting documents. 6. Claims are verified and subsidies are disbursed through direct benefit transfer.
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications can be submitted throughout the year as per scheme guidelines.
implementing_agency: Department of Industries, Government of Rajasthan

scheme_name: GVFL – Gujarat Venture Finance Ltd Fund
overview: GVFL – Gujarat Venture Finance Ltd Fund is a venture capital firm established in 1990 that provides financial and managerial support to innovative startups across various sectors in India. It manages multiple funds tailored to different startup growth stages, including pre-seed, seed, Series A, and Series B investments. GVFL focuses on sectors such as biotechnology, deep tech, clean tech, defence tech, healthcare, consumer brands, gaming, fintech, and agri-tech, offering capital along with strategic guidance and network access.
target_beneficiaries: startups
eligibility: Startups operating in sectors such as biotechnology, deep tech, enterprise tech, clean tech, defence tech, healthcare & med-tech, consumer brands, gaming & entertainment, fintech, and agri-tech are eligible for GVFL's investment funds. benefits: GVFL provides financial backing, strategic guidance, industry connections, operational support, and fundraising assistance to portfolio companies. It leverages decades of experience, extensive networks, and valuable insights to help founders build scalable and sustainable businesses.
financial_support: GVFL offers three funds: GVFL Emerging Enterprise Venture Fund (ticket size ₹5 Cr to ₹20 Cr, with follow-on possibility), GVFL Prarambh Fund (ticket size ₹50 Lakhs to ₹3 Crore), and iCreate Angel Fund (ticket size ₹25 Lakhs to ₹1.5 Cr, focused on Gujarat-based startups). overview: SAMAST is a single-window online system initiated by the Government of Madhya Pradesh to facilitate access to bank-financed government schemes. It enables citizens to apply for various state-level schemes through a unified portal after completing eKYC and profile registration. The platform supports multiple departments and banks, providing application tracking and technical support services.
target_beneficiaries: citizens; entrepreneurs; MSME; startups
eligibility: Citizens must have a valid Samagra ID with active and available registered mobile number. Aadhaar e-KYC must be completed on the Samagra portal (https://samagra.gov.in). Applicants must fully fill all sections of their profile on the SAMAST portal before submitting for any scheme benefit.
benefits: Access to apply for multiple bank-financed government schemes through a single online system. Enables eKYC verification, profile management, application submission, status tracking, and technical grievance redressal. Integrates services from 13 departments, 35 banks, and 6,530 bank branches across Madhya Pradesh.
financial_support: SAMAST is a facilitation portal and does not directly provide financial support. It enables access to bank-financed schemes offered by various government departments, where financial support (such as loans, subsidies, or grants) is provided according to the respective scheme's terms by partner banks and implementing agencies.
application_process: 1. Complete Aadhaar e-KYC on the Samagra portal (https://samagra.gov.in). 2. Register a new applicant profile on the SAMAST portal using the Samagra ID. 3. Fill all required sections of the profile with accurate and complete information. 4. Submit the profile for validation. 5. After successful profile submission, apply for desired schemes through the portal. 6. Track application status via the portal. 7. Raise technical grievances if needed through the helpdesk.
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications can be submitted year-round after profile completion.

scheme_name: Nivesh Mitra – UP Single Window Portal
overview: Nivesh Mitra – UP Single Window Portal is a state-level initiative by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to provide a unified online platform for entrepreneurs and businesses to apply for various approvals, licenses, and incentives from multiple government departments. It streamlines the application process by enabling a single Common Application Form, online payment, and real-time tracking of applications across departments such as MSME, Industrial Development Authorities, Pollution Control Board, and others. The portal aims to reduce procedural delays, enhance transparency, and improve the ease of doing business in Uttar Pradesh.
target_beneficiaries: startups; MSME; entrepreneurs; industrial units
eligibility: Entrepreneurs, industrial units, and businesses seeking approvals, licenses, or incentives from Uttar Pradesh government departments can apply through the Nivesh Mitra portal. There is no specific restriction based on entity type, turnover, or incorporation date; eligibility depends on the specific service or department being accessed via the portal.
benefits: Single window access to multiple departmental services; Common Application Form to avoid repeated filling; online payment facility via net banking, credit/debit cards; real-time application tracking; automated SMS/email alerts; digital issuance of approvals and NOCs; grievance redressal mechanism for refunds and issues; integration with departments such as MSME, Industrial Development Authorities, Pollution Control Board, and others for seamless service delivery.
financial_support: The portal facilitates online payment of fees, charges, and subsidies for various services offered by government departments. Payments are processed through a secure payment gateway supporting net banking, credit/debit cards, and are routed to the respective department’s bank account or treasury head. Refunds for excess, short, double, or incorrect payments can be requested via the Grievance Redressal section. The portal does not provide direct financial grants or loans but enables payment for government services and access to incentive schemes.
application_process: 1. Visit the Nivesh Mitra portal at https://niveshmitra.up.nic.in 2. Register on the portal using personal and contact details 3. Receive user ID and password via SMS/email 4. Log in to the portal using the credentials 5. Fill the Common Application Form and create a Unit 6. Select the desired department and service (e.g., Change of Land Use, MSME registration) 7. Attach required documents as specified for the service 8. Submit the application form online 9. Pay the applicable fee online via the payment gateway 10. Track application status using the grievance redressal or status tracking section 11. Receive digital approval/NOC upon successful processing 12. Download the certificate from the online system
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round.
implementing_agency: Invest UP, Government of Uttar Pradesh

scheme_name: KSUM Special Grants for Deep Tech
overview: KSUM Special Grants for Deep Tech is a state-level initiative by Kerala Startup Mission to support deep technology startups through financial assistance in the form of grants and seed funding. The scheme aims to help innovators move from idea validation to prototype development and early market readiness by reducing financial risk in early stages. It focuses on first-time founders, student innovators, women-led startups, and technology-driven ventures to ensure inclusive access to capital and build a strong pipeline of future-ready startups from Kerala.
target_beneficiaries: startups; student innovators; women entrepreneurs; technology-driven ventures
eligibility: The scheme is designed to support innovators and startups at the most critical phase of their journey—when ideas are taking shape and products are yet to reach the market. It is especially focused on first-time founders, student innovators, women-led startups, and technology-driven ventures, ensuring inclusive access to capital and a strong pipeline of future-ready startups from Kerala.
benefits: The scheme provides non-dilutive grants and seed funding. Specific grant types include: Idea Grant (up to ₹3 lakhs), Productisation Grant (up to ₹7 lakhs), Market Acceleration Grant (up to ₹10 lakhs), Scale-up Grant (up to ₹15 lakhs), R&D Grant (up to ₹30 lakhs), Idea Grant for Student Innovators (up to ₹2 lakhs), and Women/Transgender Productisation Grant (up to ₹12 lakhs). Benefits also include support for prototype development, market readiness, and scaling operations.
financial_support: The scheme provides non-dilutive grants and seed funding. Grants range from ₹2 lakhs for student innovators to ₹30 lakhs for R&D in deep tech/hardware startups. Seed funding includes loans such as the Seed Loan (up to ₹15 lakhs), Scaleup Seed Fund (up to ₹25 lakhs), and Women Soft Loan Scheme (up to ₹15 lakhs). Financial support is disbursed in milestone-based tranches, often with 50% released initially and the balance after progress review and utilisation certificate.
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to ₹30 lakhs for R&D Grant; up to ₹15 lakhs for Scale-up Grant; up to ₹12 lakhs for Women/Transgender Productisation Grant; up to ₹10 lakhs for Market Acceleration and Productisation Grants; up to ₹7 lakhs for Productisation Grant; up to ₹3 lakhs for Idea Grant; up to ₹2 lakhs for Idea Grant (Student Innovator)
application_process: 1. Apply through the KSUM website during the official call for applications. 2. Application is scrutinised by KSUM officials as part of initial screening; shortlisted applicants are notified via email. 3. Shortlisted startups present their idea and fund utilisation plan before the Expert Committee. 4. The Expert Committee evaluates based on Team, Product Innovation, Marketing, Financials, and Grant Utilisation Plan. 5. Approval recommendations are submitted for approval by the CEO/Chairman, KSUM. 6. Submit required documents (CA-certified No Dues & Margin Money Certificate with UDIN, revenue/investment proof, incorporation documents, PAN, KSUM Unique ID, bank details, balance sheet for last two years, stamp paper, etc.). 7. Execute agreement with KSUM at designated offices before fund release. 8. Grant is disbursed in milestone-based tranches (generally 50% first tranche, balance after progress review and utilisation certificate). 9. Submit interim progress report and utilisation certificate for second tranche release.
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted year-round as per demand, with calls for proposals issued periodically and published through official channels.
implementing_agency: Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM)
contact_details: Email: info@startupmission.in | Phone: 08047180470 | Address: Kerala Startup Mission, G3B, Thejaswini, Technopark, Trivandrum

overview: Kerala Technology Startup Policy is implemented through Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM), the nodal agency of the Government of Kerala for entrepreneurship development and incubation activities in Kerala, India. KSUM provides a comprehensive ecosystem of support including funding schemes, incubation, acceleration, market expansion, investor connections, and infrastructure to nurture startups across all stages of their journey. The policy aims to drive real change for startups by enabling access to markets, capital, partnerships, and growth opportunities, fostering a sustainable and inclusive startup ecosystem in the state.
target_beneficiaries: startups; women entrepreneurs; student innovators; technology-driven ventures; first-time founders; OBC/OEC graduates; transgender-led startups
eligibility: Eligibility varies by scheme but generally requires startup incorporation as Private Limited Company, LLP, or OPC with active MCA status, a valid KSUM Unique ID, DPIIT recognition (where applicable), work on innovative technology-based products, and compliance with specific criteria such as revenue thresholds, shareholding by Indian promoters (≥51%), and absence of pending dues with government agencies. For women-focused schemes, women/transgender founders must hold ≥51% shareholding. Student innovators may apply without company incorporation but require IEDC association for fund disbursement.
benefits: KSUM offers financial support through grants (Idea Grant up to ₹3 lakhs, Productization Grant up to ₹7 lakhs, Market Acceleration Grant up to ₹10 lakhs, Scale-up Grant up to ₹15 lakhs, R&D Grant up to ₹30 lakhs, Women/Transgender Productization Grant up to ₹12 lakhs, NIDHI Prayas Grant up to ₹10 lakhs) and loans (Seed Fund up to ₹15 lakhs, Scaleup Seed Fund up to ₹25 lakhs, Women Soft Loan up to ₹15 lakhs, NIDHI Seed Support up to ₹1 crore). Non-financial benefits include incubation and acceleration programs, mentorship, infrastructure access (e.g., Super Fablab, Digital Hub), market expansion initiatives, investor connects (Investor Café, Pitch Days), business development support, and access to global platforms. Additional support includes patent reimbursement, technology transfer schemes, and specialized grants for social impact, agriculture, and creative economy sectors.
financial_support: Financial support is delivered through a mix of non-dilutive grants and soft loans. Grants are disbursed in milestone-based tranches (typically 50% first tranche, balance after progress review and utilization certificate). Loans are provided at 6% simple interest per annum with a 12-month moratorium and repayment in 36 monthly installments. The Fund of Funds channels capital into SEBI-registered AIFs that invest in Kerala-based startups. Specific schemes like NIDHI Seed Support offer funding from ₹25 lakhs to ₹1 crore for high-potential ventures. Disbursement is account payee cheque or bank transfer to company/IEDC accounts upon submission of required documents including incorporation details, PAN, KSUM Unique ID, bank details, and utilization certificates.
application_process: 1. Visit the KSUM website and navigate to the relevant scheme page. 2. Download guidelines and check eligibility. 3. Apply online during the call for applications via the KSUM portal. 4. Submit the application form with business profile and seed proposal. 5. Upload required documents (incorporation, PAN, KSUM Unique ID, bank details, stamp paper, etc.). 6. Application scrutiny by KSUM officials. 7. Shortlisting based on eligibility and proposal quality. 8. Pitch before the Expert Committee (varies by scheme). 9. Selection based on evaluation criteria (team, product innovation, marketing, financials, fund utilization plan). 10. Execute agreement with KSUM. 11. Fund disbursement in installments based on milestone completion and utilization certificate submission.
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted year-round with periodic calls for proposals published through official channels.
implementing_agency: Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM), a nodal agency of the Government of Kerala under the Electronics and IT Department
contact_details: Email: info@startupmission.in | Phone: 08047180470 | Address: Kerala Startup Mission, G3B, Thejaswini, Technopark, Trivandrum 695581, Kerala, India

overview: The Sagarmala Port Modernisation Programme is a flagship initiative of the Government of India aimed at modernizing India's ports through port-led development, enhancing port infrastructure, improving connectivity, and promoting industrialization and coastal community development. It focuses on port modernization, new port development, port connectivity enhancement, port-linked industrialization, and coastal community development to reduce logistics costs and boost EXIM trade.
target_beneficiaries: port authorities; state governments; private sector operators; logistics providers; coastal communities
eligibility: Eligible beneficiaries include major ports under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, state governments, state maritime boards, private sector entities through public-private partnerships (PPP), and other government agencies involved in port infrastructure and connectivity projects, subject to project appraisal and approval under the Sagarmala framework.
benefits: Financial assistance for project development, infrastructure creation, and connectivity enhancement; technical support for project planning and implementation; promotion of public-private partnerships; improved port efficiency and reduced vessel turnaround time; enhanced logistics infrastructure leading to lower logistics costs; development of coastal economic zones and employment generation; skill development and sustainable livelihood projects for coastal communities.
financial_support: The programme provides financial support in the form of grants, equity, and debt financing for port modernization, connectivity projects, port-linked industrialization, and coastal community development. Funding is sourced from budgetary allocations, extra-budgetary resources, and private investment through PPP models. Specific financial mechanisms include viability gap funding (VGF), interest subordination, and capital subsidies, with disbursal tied to project milestones and approvals by the Sagarmala Apex Committee and National Sagarmala Apex Committee (NSAC).
application_process: 1. Project identification by port authorities, state governments, or implementing agencies. 2. Preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) with techno-economic feasibility. 3. Submission of DPR to the Sagarmala Cell or concerned nodal agency. 4. Appraisal by the Project Appraisal Committee (PAC) or Independent Expert Body. 5. Recommendation for approval by the Sagarmala Apex Committee. 6. Final approval by the National Sagarmala Apex Committee (NSAC). 7. Signing of Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) or Concession Agreement. 8. Disbursal of funds in tranches based on project progress. 9. Monitoring and evaluation by the Sagarmala Monitoring Cell.
deadlines: Rolling basis — project proposals can be submitted throughout the year, subject to appraisal cycles and availability of funds.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways

overview: iStart Rajasthan is an integrated startup platform launched by the Department of IT&C, Government of Rajasthan, to foster innovation and entrepreneurship across the state. It provides a comprehensive ecosystem including incubation, mentorship, funding incentives, skill development, and market access for startups at various stages. The initiative supports idea-stage founders through programs like Business Innovation Programme (BIP), Atal Innovation Studio, and LEAP, while offering financial grants and equity support based on QRate assessment.
target_beneficiaries: startups; women entrepreneurs; students; MSME
eligibility: The startup should be registered as Sole Proprietorship, Private Limited/ OPC, Limited Liable Partnership, Partnership Firm in Rajasthan or should have one operating office in Rajasthan.
benefits: Access to incubation centers (iStart Nest), mentorship programs, Learning Management System (LMS) with government-branded certificates, TalentConnect for recruitment, Business Innovation Programme (BIP), Atal Innovation Studio and Accelerator, Learn Earn And Progress (LEAP), QRate assessment for funding eligibility, financial incentives including grants up to INR 60 lakhs, Scale Up Fund up to INR 2 Crore, Startup Equity Fund matching up to INR 5 Crore, additional INR 60,000 for women-led startups, and support for IPR, procurement, and market access.
financial_support: Financial support includes Pre-Seed stage ideation grant of INR 2,40,000, Seed Stage viability grant ranging from INR 10 lakhs to INR 60 lakhs based on QRate score, additional grants for QScore improvement within defined periods, Scale Up Fund providing up to INR 2 Crore (50% of funds raised) for Gold and above QRate startups, and Startup Equity Fund where the government matches funds raised by eligible startups up to INR 5 Crore per startup. Women-led startups (>50% equity) receive an additional INR 60,000.

application_process: 1. Register on the iStart Rajasthan portal and create a profile. 2. Submit for evaluation based on eligibility criteria. 3. Apply for benefits such as grants, incubation, or mentorship. 4. Engage and grow through the platform’s resources and network.

scheme_name: NHAI InvIT – Infrastructure Investment Trust for Highways
overview: NHAI InvIT – Infrastructure Investment Trust for Highways is a financial instrument established by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) to monetize its operational highway assets through the issuance of units to investors. It enables NHAI to raise long-term capital by transferring revenue-generating road projects into a trust structure, thereby unlocking value from its infrastructure portfolio. The InvIT was listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange on 28 October 2022, with bonds issued at a 7.9% semi-annual coupon, yielding 8.05% annually, and a minimum investment of ₹10,000 for retail investors.
target_beneficiaries: investors; retail investors; institutional investors; pension funds; insurance companies; mutual funds
eligibility: The NHAI InvIT is open to all eligible investors including retail investors, institutional investors, pension funds, insurance companies, and mutual funds who comply with SEBI (Infrastructure Investment Trusts) Regulations, 2014. There are no restrictions based on entity type, geography, or investor category, subject to KYC and AML norms as per applicable securities laws.
benefits: Investors in NHAI InvIT benefit from regular income distribution derived from toll and annuity revenues of underlying highway assets, potential capital appreciation, diversification into infrastructure asset class, transparency through SEBI-regulated disclosures, and liquidity via listing on stock exchanges. The structure offers tax-efficient returns as interest income is exempt from dividend distribution tax, and the InvIT model allows for passive investment in operational roads without direct operational involvement.
financial_support: NHAI InvIT issued secured, rated, listed, redeemable, non-convertible debentures (bonds) with a 25-year maturity period. The bonds carry a 7.9% semi-annual coupon, resulting in an effective annual yield of 8.05%. Retail participation was encouraged by setting a minimum investment amount of ₹10,000. The issue was oversubscribed and closed early due to strong demand across investor classes.
application_process: 1. Investors must have a demat and trading account with a registered stockbroker. 2. Units of NHAI InvIT can be purchased through the stock exchange (BSE/NSE) during market hours using the scrip code. 3. For anchor allocation in the IPO, eligible institutional investors submitted bids through Book Running Lead Managers as per the offer document. 4. Post-listing, units are traded freely on the exchange like any other equity security. 5. Income distributions are made periodically to unit holders based on cash flows from the underlying highway projects.
deadlines: Rolling basis — units can be bought and sold anytime during market hours post-listing
implementing_agency: National Highways Authority of India (NHAI)

overview: National Highway Logistics Facilities (NHLF) is a scheme under the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) aimed at developing logistics infrastructure along national highways to improve freight movement and supply chain efficiency. The scheme focuses on creating multimodal logistics parks, warehousing, and related facilities to reduce logistics costs and enhance connectivity. It supports the broader goal of integrating highways with logistics networks under initiatives like Bharatmala and Sagarmala.
target_beneficiaries: logistics companies; MSME; warehouse operators; freight forwarders; transport operators
eligibility: Eligible beneficiaries include companies, consortiums, or special purpose vehicles (SPVs) registered under the Companies Act, 2013 or LLP Act, 2008, with proven experience in logistics, warehousing, or infrastructure development, and meeting financial and technical criteria as specified in the tender documents issued by NHAI for each project.
benefits: Access to developed logistics parks with plug-and-play infrastructure, long-term land leases on NHAI land, connectivity to national highways and expressways, proximity to industrial clusters and ports, facilitation of customs clearance and EXIM procedures, availability of plug-and-play utilities, and opportunities for value-added services like packaging, labeling, and cold storage.
financial_support: Financial support is provided through viability gap funding (VGF), subsidies, or equity participation in public-private partnership (PPP) models, with the quantum and mechanism determined on a project-to-project basis as per the concession agreement and bidding documents.
application_process: 1. Monitor NHAI tender notifications for NHLF-related projects on the official website. 2. Review the Request for Proposal (RFP) and eligibility criteria for specific logistics park projects. 3. Prepare technical and financial bids as per the tender documents. 4. Submit the bid online through the NHAI e-tender portal before the deadline. 5. Attend pre-bid meetings if scheduled. 6. Await technical and financial evaluation by NHAI. 7. If selected, enter into a concession agreement with NHAI. 8. Fulfill conditions precedent and commence development as per the project timeline.
deadlines: Project-specific; varies per tender notification
implementing_agency: National Highways Authority of India (NHAI)

overview: The National Waterway Development – IWAI Schemes focus on the development and regulation of inland waterways for shipping and navigation in India. The Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI), established in 1986, undertakes projects for development and maintenance of IWT infrastructure on national waterways through grants received from the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways. IWAI has developed 111 National Waterways (NWs) across India, with a total length of 20,187 km, and promotes inland water transport (IWT) through infrastructure development, navigational aids, and schemes like the Cargo Promotion Scheme to incentivize modal shift from road and rail to IWT.
target_beneficiaries: cargo owners; shipping companies; state governments; MSME; entrepreneurs
eligibility: Eligibility varies by sub-scheme. For the Cargo Promotion Scheme, cargo owners shifting cargo from rail/road to IWT on NW-1, NW-2, and NW-16 via IBP route for long-haul movements (>300 km) are eligible, excluding short-haul, Ro-Ro, Ro-Pax, ODC movements, and transport by ICSL. For internships, candidates pursuing/completed graduate/post-graduate courses from reputed institutions with minimum 75% in 12th (UG) or 60% in graduation (PG) are eligible. For deputation posts, applicants must be from Central/State Govt./PSUs/Statutory bodies with analogous posts, required qualifications, and experience as specified in individual recruitment notices.
benefits: Financial incentives of 35% of total actual operating expenditure on waterways journey for cargo owners under the Cargo Promotion Scheme. Infrastructure development including terminals, jetties, navigational aids, and fairway maintenance. Provision of Least Available Depth (LAD) data for safe navigation. Support for river cruise tourism through operational stretches and jetty development. Internship stipend of Rs. 10,000/month for undergraduates and Rs. 20,000/month for postgraduates/research scholars. Employment opportunities on deputation basis in various technical and administrative roles.
financial_support: Under the Cargo Promotion Scheme, financial incentives are provided to the extent of 35% of the total actual operating expenditure incurred on waterways journey for sustainable modal shift of cargo from road or rail to IWT. The scheme is currently proposed at a cost of less than 100 Crore for three years and can be scaled up or modified based on success. IWAI undertakes projects for development and maintenance of IWT infrastructure on national waterways through grant received from the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways.
application_process: For the Cargo Promotion Scheme: 1. Register online with ICSL on a portal developed by ICSL. 2. Submit applications with details of cargo to be transported, planned route, plan for modal shift for 5 years, and other relevant information. 3. Commit to cargo volumes for 3 years for modal shift to IWT and undertake regular movements on NW-1, NW-2, NW-16 and transit movements using Indo Bangladesh Protocol routes. 4. Applications examined and approved by the Steering Committee. 5. Maintain accurate records, voyage log book, documents, and reports related to transportation via IWT. 6. Submit periodic reports detailing quantity of cargo transported, routes used, modal shift achieved, and other relevant data. 7. For fund disbursement, submit documents including Bill of coastal goods, Shipper’s Certificate, Receiver’s Certificate, Port’s Invoice, Terminals Invoice, Lock Gate charges, Vessel related expenses (fuel, manning, insurance), Customs Clearance & Immigration Documents (if applicable), and other valid invoices. 8. Funds disbursed within 7 days of receipt of all requisite documents (GST bills only). 9. All documents and payment requests submitted online. For internships: 1. Send applications along with CVs in prescribed format to The Secretary, IWAI, A-13, Sector-1, Noida-201301. 2. Clearly indicate area of interest and preferred division. 3. Produce a letter from Head of Department/Principal indicating status and 'No Objection' for internship. 4. Applications processed by Recruitment and Training Cell at IWAI. 5. Applications scrutinized by Head Office/respective Directorate. 6. Actual offers sent to selected interns subject to availability of slots, consent of Division, and approval of Competent Authority.
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round for internships and deputation posts as per periodic employment notices. For the Cargo Promotion Scheme, the scheme is initially valid for a period of 3 years.
implementing_agency: Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI)
contact_details: Email: nsingh@iwai.gov.in | Phone No. 0120-2474050 (Internship Programme contact)

scheme_name: Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM) for Highway Projects
overview: The Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM) for Highway Projects is a public-private partnership (PPP) model used by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for the development, operation, and maintenance of national highway projects. Under HAM, the government provides 40% of the project cost as construction support in five equal instalments during the construction period, while the remaining 60% is paid as annuity payments over the operation period along with interest. The model aims to reduce the financial burden on private developers and ensure timely project completion.
target_beneficiaries: private developers; infrastructure companies; construction firms
eligibility: Private companies, consortia, or special purpose vehicles (SPVs) incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 or earlier, with relevant experience in highway construction, operation, and maintenance, meeting the technical and financial criteria specified in the bid documents, and capable of providing the required equity and guarantees as per NHAI guidelines.
benefits: Reduced equity requirement for private developers (only 40% of project cost as construction support), annuity payments with interest over the operation period, lower financial risk compared to BOT models, government bears construction cost overruns, and the model attracts investment due to assured returns.
financial_support: Under HAM, the government provides 40% of the total project cost as construction support in five equal instalments during the construction phase. The remaining 60% is paid as bi-annual annuity payments over the operation period (typically 15 years) along with interest on the outstanding amount. The annuity is calculated to provide a reasonable return on investment to the concessionaire.
application_process: 1. NHAI invites bids for HAM projects through competitive bidding. 2. Interested applicants must purchase the bid documents by paying the prescribed fee. 3. Applicants must submit their pre-qualification or bid documents online via the NHAI portal https://nhai.gov.in. 4.
