scheme_name: DBT Wellcome India Alliance Research Grants
overview: The DBT Wellcome India Alliance Research Grants, administered by the DBT/Wellcome Trust India Alliance (India Alliance), is a Cabinet-approved Biomedical Research Career Programme (BRCP) established in 2009 to strengthen and advance biomedical research in India. It supports researchers across career stages through fellowships, collaborative grants, and research management initiatives, aiming to drive discovery and innovation while building equitable research capacity. The programme is funded by the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), India, and Wellcome Trust (WT), UK, with Phase-III approved in October 2025 at a total cost of ₹1500 Crore (DBT:WT contributions in 2:1 ratio) for FY 2025/26 to 2030/31, followed by a service period through 2037/38.
target_beneficiaries: researchers; early-career scientists; intermediate researchers; senior scientists; clinicians; public health researchers; biomedical scientists; research managers
eligibility: The programme supports researchers across career stages including Early Career, Intermediate, Senior, and Margdarshi Fellowships for basic biomedical scientists, clinicians, public health researchers, and veterinarians who wish to pursue academic research in India. It also supports collaborative grants and research management fellowships. Applicants must be affiliated with Indian institutions and demonstrate excellence in their respective fields.
benefits: Fellows receive protected time and funding to pursue independent research programmes, access to mentorship and engagement activities, opportunities for national and international collaborations, training through workshops (e.g., Science Communication, Leadership Courses), and support for public engagement initiatives. The programme also provides access to the IASys grants management system for transparent and efficient award administration.
financial_support: Financial support is provided through research fellowships that cover salary, research expenses, and related costs at different career stages. Collaborative grants support small investigator teams (2–3 investigators) for innovative research. The Research Management Programme offers fellowships, institutional grants, and travel bursaries for research managers. Funding is mediated through the DBT/Wellcome Trust India Alliance, with disbursement managed via the IASys online grants management system.
application_process: 1. Identify the appropriate fellowship or grant type based on career stage and research focus. 2. Check the specific competition application dates for the desired scheme (e.g., MCG: 01 April - 15 May 2026, CDG: 16 Mar - 18 May 2026). 3. Prepare the required application documents as per the scheme guidelines. 4. Submit the application online through the India Alliance portal during the open window. 5. Applications are reviewed by international selection committees. 6. Selected candidates are notified and awarded fellowships or grants. 7. Funds are disbursed through the IASys system upon award confirmation.
deadlines: MCG: 01 April - 15 May 2026; CDG: 16 Mar - 18 May 2026; CCG: 16 Mar - 18 May 2026; ECF - Basic: 02 Feb - 16 March 2026; IF - Basic: 20 Feb - 23 March 2026; ECF - CPH: 20 Feb - 23 March 2026; IF - CPH: 20 Feb - 23 March 2026; RMP: 02 Feb - 10 April 2026
implementing_agency: DBT/Wellcome Trust India Alliance (India Alliance)

scheme_name: NHSRC – National Health Systems Resource Centre Tech Grants
overview: The National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is a premier Think Tank for the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), established in 2007, mandated to assist in policy and strategy development, provision and mobilization of technical assistance to states, and capacity building for the Ministry of Health. It operates as an apex body under the National Rural Health Mission (NRHM) to improve health outcomes through governance reform, health systems innovations, and improved information sharing. NHSRC supports various health initiatives including the FC-XV Health Grants through Local Governments, which involves financial allocations for health sector development.
target_beneficiaries: states; Union Territories; local governments
eligibility: States and Union Territories are eligible to receive FC-XV Health Grants through Local Governments based on technical and operational guidelines issued by the Department of Expenditure (DoE) for the period 2021-22 to 2025-26, with proposals requiring approval from the National Committee under FC-XV Health Grants.
benefits: Financial support for health sector strengthening at the local government level, technical guidance for grant utilization, capacity building for effective implementation, and alignment with national health priorities under the Fifteenth Finance Commission (XV-FC) health sector grants.
financial_support: The FC-XV Health Grants through Local Governments provide financial allocations to states for health sector development as per the Fifteenth Finance Commission recommendations, with guidelines issued by the Department of Expenditure for the period 2021-22 to 2025-26, and funds released upon approval by the National Committee under FC-XV Health Grants.
application_process: 1. States submit proposals for FC-XV Health Grants through Local Governments to the National Health Systems Resource Centre. 2. Proposals are reviewed by the National Committee under FC-XV Health Grants chaired by the Secretary, Health and Family Welfare. 3. Approved proposals are forwarded to the Department of Expenditure for fund release. 4. Funds are released to states upon receipt of approval letters and compliance with technical and operational guidelines. 5. States utilize funds for approved health sector activities and submit utilization reports.
deadlines: Based on Fifteenth Finance Commission award period (2021-22 to 2025-26); specific submission windows communicated via official circulars
implementing_agency: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC)
contact_details: Email: Not explicitly stated in evidence; Contact via NHSRC website: https://nhsrcindia.org

overview: The National e-Governance Division (NeGD) EdTech Innovation scheme is a government initiative under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY) aimed at fostering innovation in educational technology through the development and deployment of digital platforms and services. NeGD, established in 2009 as an independent business division under the Digital India Corporation, supports MeitY in programme management and implementation of e-Governance projects, providing technical and advisory support to central and state governments. The scheme focuses on building national public digital platforms such as DigiLocker, UMANG, API Setu, myScheme, and others to enable seamless, secure, and scalable digital service delivery across government silos. It promotes innovation, interoperability, and citizen-centric digital governance through initiatives like API Setu, OpenForge, and AI-driven solutions for government platforms.
target_beneficiaries: startups; MSME; government departments; citizens
eligibility: NeGD invites applications for onboarding of API Solution/Service providers, including private API providers, on API Setu. The Service Provider must be an Indian Company/LLP/Partnership firm registered under the applicable Act in India and should have existed continuously for at least the last 3 completed fiscal years as of the date of Onboarding request. The Service Provider must have an average turnover of a minimum of Rs. 10 crores during the last 03 fiscal years (FY 2021-22, FY2022-23, FY 2023-24). The Service Provider should be a profitable organization on the basis of profit before tax (PBT) for the last 03 fiscal years. The Service Provider should have experience of minimum 3 years in providing solutions/services which includes development, implementation and operation/maintenance of API technologies, including RESTful APIs, and API management platforms for a period of at least the last three completed financial years. MSME agencies registered with the Government are exempted from turnover criteria.
benefits: Onboarded API service providers gain access to government projects and can offer seamless API integrations, promote interoperability, enable secure and scalable data exchange, provide value-added services such as API analytics, monitoring, lifecycle management, and versioning, support microservices architecture and emerging API frameworks, and ensure consistent API management for government back-end services. They contribute to a robust API ecosystem that enhances service delivery across Government-to-Citizen (G2C), Government-to-Business (G2B), and Government-to-Government (G2G) interfaces. The platform records approximately 80 million transactions monthly and hosts over 2000 partners with more than 6400 published APIs. Providers also benefit from standardized API onboarding processes, sandbox testing, compliance validation, and integration with NeGD’s reporting dashboards for automated KPI tracking.
financial_support: The API Setu onboarding initiative does not provide direct financial support, grants, or subsidies to service providers. Instead, it offers a platform for API providers to publish, manage, and monetize their APIs through secure, scalable, and interoperable data exchange with government entities. Revenue generation is based on mutual agreements between API providers and government consumers, with API Setu enabling transparent billing, token consumption tracking, and usage analytics. There is no mention of fund size, grants, loans, or subsidies in the evidence. The initiative focuses on enabling business opportunities through platform access rather than direct financial assistance.
application_process:
1. Review the Guidelines for Onboarding on API Setu document available at https://negd-media.digitalindiacorporation.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Guidelines-for-Onboarding-for-API-as-a-service-provider-v15-Rev-1-1.pdf
2. Ensure eligibility as per Annexure VII (Service Provider’s Eligibility Criteria) including company registration, minimum 3 years existence, Rs. 10 crore average turnover (exempt for MSMEs), profitability, quality certifications, compliance, experience, and non-blacklisting
3. Prepare required documents: Certificate of Incorporation, PAN, GST registration, audited balance sheets, CA certificates, quality certifications, undertaking on litigations, undertaking on blacklisting, technical capability statement, work orders/completion certificates
4. Submit Request for Onboarding via email to partners.apisetu@digitalindia.gov.in
5. Await technical presentation notification (to be notified)
6. Undergo evaluation based on eligibility, technical capability, and business purpose alignment
7. Upon approval, sign contract and legal agreements
8. Complete registration, submit API documentation, undergo compliance, security, and privacy review
9. Undergo technical review and sandbox testing
10. Sign contract and receive approval for API publication
11. Maintain performance as per Annexure VII and integrate with NeGD’s reporting dashboards for KPI tracking
12. Ensure resolution time of 4 hours for any issue in the solution or individual APIs
deadlines: The Request for Onboarding process is ongoing. The date of commencement was 13th May 2025. The last date for receiving comments (via email to partners.apisetu@digitalindia.gov.in) was 25th May, 2025. The last date and time for Request for Onboarding Submission (Round 1) was 30th May, 2025. Submissions remain open and are evaluated on an ongoing basis.
implementing_agency: National e-Governance Division (NeGD), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India

scheme_name: AICTE Idea Lab – Innovation & Design Excellence for Students
overview: The AICTE Idea Lab – Innovation & Design Excellence for Students is a scheme aimed at fostering innovation and design thinking among students by establishing Idea Labs in AICTE-approved institutions. These labs provide infrastructure and support for students to develop prototypes, work on innovative projects, and engage in hands-on learning experiences. The initiative encourages interdisciplinary collaboration and aims to strengthen the innovation ecosystem in technical education across India.
target_beneficiaries: students
eligibility: AICTE-approved institutions (such as engineering colleges, polytechnics, and universities) are eligible to apply for setting up an AICTE Idea Lab under this scheme.
benefits: Selected institutions receive financial support for setting up Idea Labs equipped with prototyping tools, design software, and innovation infrastructure. Students gain access to mentorship, workshops, and opportunities to participate in national-level innovation challenges and exhibitions. The labs foster creativity, problem-solving skills, and industry-academia collaboration.
financial_support: AICTE provides a one-time grant-in-aid to selected institutions for the establishment of Idea Labs. The financial support covers procurement of equipment, software, and initial setup costs. The exact quantum of support may vary based on the proposal and institutional requirements, subject to AICTE norms and guidelines.
application_process: 1. AICTE-approved institutions must submit a proposal online through the AICTE Idea Lab portal. 2. The proposal should include details about the institution, objectives, planned activities, budget, and expected outcomes. 3. Proposals are evaluated by an expert committee based on innovation potential, feasibility, and alignment with scheme goals. 4. Selected institutions receive approval and financial sanction from AICTE. 5. Upon approval, institutions proceed with setting up the Idea Lab as per the approved plan. 6. Institutions are required to submit utilization certificates and progress reports to AICTE after implementation.
deadlines: Rolling basis — proposals are accepted throughout the year subject to availability of funds and AICTE announcements.
implementing_agency: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

scheme_name: Logistics Data Bank (LDB) Service Provider Scheme
overview: The Logistics Data Bank (LDB) Service Provider Scheme is a government initiative aimed at enhancing supply chain visibility and efficiency in India's logistics sector by providing real-time tracking of container movements through RFID technology. It enables stakeholders such as shippers, consignees, transporters, and port authorities to access accurate, unified data on EXIM container transit times and bottlenecks. The scheme supports data-driven decision-making to reduce dwell times, improve port productivity, and strengthen India's trade logistics infrastructure.
target_beneficiaries: logistics service providers; technology providers; port operators; shipping lines; customs brokers; freight forwarders
eligibility: Entities providing logistics technology solutions, including RFID-based tracking, data integration, and analytics services, that meet technical and operational standards set by the Logistics Data Bank Limited (LDBL) and are capable of integrating with the LDB platform to deliver real-time container tracking services.
benefits: Access to a unified, real-time EXIM container tracking platform; improved operational efficiency through reduced dwell times and optimized routing; enhanced transparency for shippers and consignees; data analytics for performance benchmarking; integration with port, customs, and railway systems; support for policy formulation and infrastructure planning; and contribution to national logistics cost reduction goals.
financial_support: The scheme does not provide direct financial support, grants, or subsidies to service providers. Participation is based on technical qualification and service delivery under commercial or contractual arrangements with LDBL or its authorized partners. Revenue is generated through service fees paid by users of the LDB platform.
application_process: 1. Visit the official Logistics Data Bank website at https://www.logisticsdatabank.in 2. Review the eligibility and technical requirements for service providers 3. Submit an expression of interest or application through the designated channel on the portal 4. Undergo technical evaluation by LDBL for compatibility with the LDB platform 5. Sign a service agreement or memorandum of understanding upon approval 6. Complete integration and testing of services with the LDB system 7. Go live as an authorized service provider and begin offering tracking solutions.
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year subject to technical evaluation cycles.
implementing_agency: Logistics Data Bank Limited (LDBL), a special purpose vehicle promoted by the Ministry of Railways and Ministry of Commerce and Industry

scheme_name: Freight Operations Information System (FOIS) Startup Integration
DIKSHA Platform for EdTech Startup Integration
overview: DIKSHA (Digital Infrastructure for Knowledge Sharing) is a national platform for school education, an initiative of the National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Launched in 2017, it serves as a digital learning ecosystem providing energized textbooks, teacher professional development, content authoring, quizzes, virtual labs, and multilingual resources aligned with the National Education Policy 2020. The platform supports students, teachers, parents, and administrators across India with content in 135 languages and enables access to education through diverse modes including online, offline, and broadcast media.
target_beneficiaries: students; teachers; parents; administrators; learners
eligibility: DIKSHA is accessible to learners and teachers across the country; no specific eligibility criteria are mentioned for general usage. Content contribution is open to individuals, teachers, educationists, subject experts, schools, government and non-government organisations after registering and nominating themselves under the VidyaDaan program.
benefits: Access to energized textbooks with QR codes, teacher professional development, question banks, content sourcing and authoring tools, quizzes, data tools and dashboards, chatbot, digital credentials, collaboration features, phygital learning, cQube analytics, surveys, language translations, mentoring, Sunbird Registry and Credentials, virtual labs, and multilingual resources in 135 languages. The platform supports offline access via printed energized textbooks (600 Million+ distributed) and online access through web and mobile applications.
financial_support: No direct financial support is provided to end-users under the DIKSHA platform. The platform itself is funded through government budget allocations as part of the Ministry of Education's initiatives, with implementation supported via a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model involving EkStep Foundation as a technology and program management partner.
application_process: 1. Access DIKSHA via website (diksha.gov.in) or mobile app. 2. Select preferred language, board, grade, and subject. 3. Browse or search for textbooks, videos, interactive content, or courses. 4. For content contribution, register under VidyaDaan by nominating oneself as an individual, teacher, school, or organisation. 5. Upload e-learning resources such as explanation videos, teaching videos, practice questions, lesson plans, etc., ensuring open licensing under Creative Commons. 6. Contributions are reviewed by state/UT or CBSE authorities; accepted content is curated and made available on the platform.
deadlines: Rolling basis — content contributions and platform usage are accepted year-round with no fixed deadlines.
implementing_agency: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT), Ministry of Education, Government of India

scheme_name: Port Community System (PCS1x) Startup Partner Programme
overview: The Port Community System (PCS1x) Startup Partner Programme is an initiative by PCS1x, a digital platform for port logistics, to collaborate with startups in the logistics technology sector. The programme aims to integrate innovative startup solutions into the PCS1x platform to enhance efficiency, transparency, and digital transformation in port operations. Startups are invited to partner with PCS1x to co-develop and deploy technology solutions that address challenges in the maritime logistics ecosystem.
target_beneficiaries: startups
eligibility: Startups operating in the logistics technology space with innovative solutions relevant to port operations, maritime logistics, or supply chain management are eligible to apply as partners to the PCS1x Startup Partner Programme.
benefits: Selected startups gain access to the PCS1x platform for integration and deployment of their solutions, opportunities to co-develop with port stakeholders, visibility within the port community ecosystem, technical support from PCS1x, and potential pathways to scale their products across major ports in India.
financial_support: The evidence does not specify any direct financial support, grants, loans, or funding amounts provided to startups under the PCS1x Startup Partner Programme. The collaboration appears to be focused on technical integration, platform access, and co-development rather than monetary assistance.
application_process: 1. Visit the PCS1x website at https://www.pcs1x.com 2. Navigate to the Startup Partner Programme section 3. Express interest in partnering with PCS1x 4. Provide details about the startup and its technology solution 5. Await review by the PCS1x team 6. Engage in discussions for potential integration and collaboration.
deadlines: Rolling basis
implementing_agency: PCS1x

scheme_name: NIT Startup – National Institute of Technology Incubation Seed Fund
overview: The NIT Startup – National Institute of Technology Incubation Seed Fund is a scheme under AICTE aimed at supporting EduTech startups through incubation and seed funding. It is designed to foster innovation and entrepreneurship among students and faculty in technical institutions by providing financial and non-financial support for early-stage ventures. The scheme focuses on nurturing innovative ideas that contribute to national goals like Atmanirbhar Bharat and Viksit Bharat@2047. It operates under the AICTE Productization Fellowship (APF) initiative, which supports innovative ideas driving future economic growth.
target_beneficiaries: startups; students; faculty; EduTech startups
eligibility: The scheme is open to students, faculty, and startups from AICTE-approved institutions. Applicants must be part of an AICTE-approved institution and have an innovative idea in the EduTech sector that aligns with national goals like Atmanirbhar Bharat and Viksit Bharat@2047. The idea should be in the early stage and require incubation and seed funding support.
benefits: The scheme provides financial support in the form of seed funding, incubation support, mentorship, access to infrastructure, industry-academia collaboration opportunities, and guidance for product development and market readiness. It also offers networking opportunities with investors and industry experts, and support for scaling innovative EduTech solutions.
financial_support: The scheme provides seed funding to selected EduTech startups through the NIT Startup – National Institute of Technology Incubation Seed Fund. The financial support is provided as a grant or seed investment to help startups develop their product, conduct market validation, and scale operations. The exact quantum and mechanism of disbursement are not specified in the evidence.
application_process: 1. Register on the AICTE portal for the AICTE Productization Fellowship (APF) initiative. 2. Submit an application for the NIT Startup – National Institute of Technology Incubation Seed Fund through the designated portal. 3. Provide details of the innovative EduTech idea, team, and institution. 4. Submit required documents including proof of institution approval, team details, and project proposal. 5. overview: The Gujarat State New IT/ITeS Policy 2022-27 is a state-level initiative by the Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat, aimed at fostering the growth of the IT and IT-enabled services sector in the state. It provides a framework for incentives, infrastructure development, and skill enhancement to attract investments and promote innovation in the IT/ITeS domain. scheme_name: National Logistics Policy – Ease of Logistics (ELOG)
overview: The National Logistics Policy – Ease of Logistics (ELOG) is a Government of India initiative aimed at improving logistics efficiency, reducing logistics costs, and enhancing competitiveness of Indian goods in domestic and international markets. It focuses on integrated development of the logistics sector through policy interventions, infrastructure development, technology adoption, and skill development. The policy aims to create a seamless, technology-driven, and integrated logistics ecosystem across the country.

eligibility: The policy applies to all stakeholders in the logistics ecosystem including logistics service providers, infrastructure developers, technology providers, manufacturers, traders, e-commerce companies, agri-logistics entities, and startups operating in the logistics sector across India. There are no specific eligibility restrictions as it is a policy framework rather than a beneficiary-specific scheme.
benefits: The policy provides a framework for integrated development of the logistics sector including: development of multimodal logistics parks, implementation of a Unified Logistics Interface Platform (ULIP) for seamless data exchange, standardization of logistics processes, skill development and capacity building in logistics, promotion of green logistics, improvement of first and last mile connectivity, reduction in logistics costs and time, enhancement of cargo safety and security, and creation of a conducive policy environment for logistics innovation and investment.
financial_support: The National Logistics Policy – Ease of Logistics (ELOG) is a policy framework and does not provide direct financial support to entities. Financial support for logistics infrastructure and initiatives is provided through various central and state government schemes, public-private partnerships, and institutional financing. The policy enables convergence of existing schemes and facilitates access to funding through various government programs.

scheme_name: NICDC Logistics Data Services for Startups
overview: The NICDC Logistics Data Services for Startups scheme is part of the National Industrial Corridor Development Programme, focusing on developing logistics infrastructure to support industrial growth. It aims to create investment-ready industrial parks with plug-and-play facilities, multimodal connectivity, and sustainable infrastructure to attract domestic and global investments. The scheme is implemented through Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs) and provides financial assistance for developing industrial parks across multiple phases.
target_beneficiaries: startups; MSME; industrial units; investors
eligibility: The sponsoring agency/authority must satisfy mandatory criteria including land area requirements (minimum 100 acre contiguous land in non-hilly states, 25 acre in hilly states/northeast/UTs/population <1 crore), land ownership by State Government, Private Developer, jointly, or CPSE, with 90% encumbrance-free land in possession at application submission. Planning and development powers must be delegated to the SPV by the State/UT Government. Both greenfield and brownfield parks are eligible subject to availability of unencumbered, litigation-free, contiguous and unallotted land.
benefits: Benefits include plug-and-play infrastructure with 24-hour power supply, potable and recycled water, effluent treatment plants, multi-modal connectivity, gas pipelines, integrated city planning, robust telecom networks, single-window clearance, E-land management, anchor investor discounts, flexible payment plans, incentives from Union and State Governments, sustainable initiatives (green and clean businesses only, underground power network, ICT-based infrastructure optimization, SCADA system for monitoring), and social infrastructure (educational facilities, healthcare services, housing, recreational amenities).
financial_support: Financial assistance is provided by the Central Government through NICDIT in the form of equity, released in tranches linked to achievement of predefined milestones. The equity participation of NICDIT in any SPV shall not exceed 50% of the paid-up equity capital. For SPVs formed between NICDIT and the State Government/State Nodal Agency without private participation, the shareholding pattern shall not be altered. In private developer-led projects, transfer or sale or disinvestment of equity share is permissible after five years from project completion and operationalization.
application_process: 1. Applications are invited in two or more phases, with up to 50 projects in the first phase. 2. Application must be submitted by the sponsoring agency/authority in prescribed format through the designated portal. 3. Each application must be accompanied by a Detailed Project Report (DPR) prepared as per indicative template in Annexure II. 4. If the State Government is the sponsoring authority, application must be submitted after due consideration and clear recommendation of the State Level Committee (SLC). 5. If a CPSE is the sponsoring agency, application must be submitted with approval of the Board of CPSE and compliance with Government of India instructions. 6. Applications are received and processed through an online portal developed and managed by Project Management Agency (PMA). 7. The portal is opened for submission for a specified period following due public notice. 8. Applications meeting mandatory eligibility criteria are evaluated on multi-modal connectivity, site suitability, quality of core/value-added/social infrastructure, industrial ecosystem, and policy enablers. 9. Highest-ranking applications scoring above benchmark threshold are shortlisted for DPR examination and evaluation. 10. An appraisal report is prepared by PMA and presented before the National Level Steering Committee (NLSC) for approval.
deadlines: Applications are invited in two or more phases; the portal is opened for a specified period following due public notice.
implementing_agency: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India

scheme_name: ICMR Extramural Research Grants for MedTech
overview: The ICMR Extramural Research Grants for MedTech provide financial assistance to Indian scientists working outside ICMR institutes to conduct research in medicine, public health, and allied disciplines aimed at improving health of Indians. The scheme supports various types of grants including small, intermediate, and Centre for Advanced Research (CAR) grants, with a focus on innovation, validation of interventions, and development of breakthrough health technologies. It encourages multidisciplinary projects and prioritizes research aligned with ICMR's national health priorities.
target_beneficiaries: scientists; researchers; medical colleges; research institutes; universities; recognized research and development laboratories; government and semi-government organizations; NGOs
eligibility: Non-ICMR Indian Scientists/ Professionals who have a regular employment in the Medical College, Research Institute, University, Recognized Research and Development Laboratory, Govt. and Semi Govt. Organization and NGOs. An eligible co-Principal Investigator should be included in the project i.e. a regular employee in the PI’s organization. ICMR scientists are not eligible to apply under this call. ICMR scientists may be named as co-investigators in these projects, but no funds will be given for ICMR institutions or scientists in these cases.
benefits: Financial support for research projects, access to ICMR's research infrastructure, mentorship opportunities, collaboration with ICMR institutes, recognition through ICMR's extramural research programme, and support for translating innovative ideas into impactful healthcare solutions.
financial_support: ICMR provides financial assistance through various grant types: ICMR SMALL Extramural Grants (up to 2 crores per project), ICMR SMALL Follow on Extramural Grants (up to 2 crores per project), ICMR Intermediate Extramural Grants (between 2-8 crores per project), ICMR Intermediate Extramural Grants Follow on (between 2-8 crores per project), Investigator Initiated First in World Challenge (FIWC) (up to 8 crore as per stage of innovation), Investigator Initiated Center for Advanced Research (CAR) (15 crores per CAR), Clinical Care Excellence Initiative (maximum 8 crores per project), and NHRP projects (up to Rs 25Cr for each project over the entire period, with funding up to Rs 8 Cr/site). Funds are released in one installment per year, with the first installment released along with the sanction letter for equipment and recurring expenditure up to 31st March of the financial year. Subsequent years' funds are released after receipt of annual progress report and Statement of Expenditure from the previous year.
application_process: 1. Before proceeding to submit the proposal, read user manual and ICMR Extramural Research Program guidelines and make ready all relevant information, documents and research plan. 2. Open the ICMR Electronics Project Management System (e-PMS) portal at https://epms.icmr.org.in. The user manual of e-PMS (under Guidelines → e-PMS manual) is available on the portal. 3. Project proposal submission is a three-step process in e-PMS: Step 1: PI registration/Login (https://epms.icmr.org.in/userLogin); Step 2: Verify email ID and complete/update PI profile; Step 3: Proposal submission. 4. After completing mandatory section of PI profile, click on 'Proposal submission → Click on Submit new proposal → Select the program from drop-down box as "Investigator-initiated Research Proposals" → Fill the form step by step. 5. It is advised to carefully read the budget provision available under Guidelines for Extramural Research Programme of ICMR and submit the budget in prescribed format. 6. Including at least one Co-PI from PI’s institute is mandatory. 7. PIs are advised to submit proposal well ahead of the last date, since servers may be overloaded and slow to respond. 8. For any technical queries related to the call, please contact PO-EPMS at Division of BMI, ICMR Headquarters, V Ramalingaswami Bhawan, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029, Email: po.epms@icmr.gov.in; Phone No: 011-2658988.
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round.

financial_support: IEDCs receive early risk capital and accreditation-linked grants based on performance. Funding is provided to top-performing IEDCs, with specific grant amounts tied to milestones such as generating at least two startups and two patents annually from each IEDC.
application_process: 1. Interested institutions submit online application form via the KSUM website. 2. KSUM verifies submitted applications based on data and recommendations for sanctioning. 3. KSUM issues sanction order to selected IEDCs that have passed verification and due diligence. 4. Selected IEDCs receive Unique Identity Number upon meeting mandatory conditions.
deadlines: New leads should be elected and take charge of IEDC on or before 31 January 2024. If existing leads graduate on or after 31 December 2024, their data is considered; otherwise, new leads are selected.
implementing_agency: Kerala Startup Mission

overview: Kerala Startup Mission Angel Network is part of the Ignite - Investor Education Program, which equips High Net-Worth Individuals (HNIs) and Ultra High Net-Worth Individuals (UHNIs) with knowledge, tools, and frameworks to participate confidently in startup investing. The program focuses on building understanding of the startup investment ecosystem, including deal evaluation, risk assessment, portfolio construction, and long-term value creation. Through structured learning modules, practical tools, and curated access to high-quality startup opportunities, IGNITE enables participants to make informed investment decisions and engage meaningfully as angel investors.
target_beneficiaries: HNIs; UHNIs; individuals interested in startup and early-stage investments
eligibility: Eligibility Criteria Applicants must meet the eligibility requirements specified under the scheme guidelines. High Net-Worth Individuals (HNIs) Ultra High Net-Worth Individuals (UHNIs) Individuals interested in startup and early-stage investments
benefits: 01 Structured understanding of startup investing and angel investing 02 Tools and frameworks for deal evaluation and risk assessment 03 Insights into portfolio construction and investment lifecycle 04 Curated access to startups and ecosystem experts 05 Improved confidence in making informed investment decisions
financial_support: The program does not provide direct financial support to startups; it focuses on investor education to enhance angel investing capabilities.
application_process: 1. Apply Now via the KSUM website 2. Submit application through the official KSUM/IGNITE portal during call for proposals 3. Preliminary screening and technical evaluation by KSUM 4. Presentation before the PRAYAS Monitoring Committee (PMC) 5. Evaluation based on innovation, technical feasibility, prototype development plan, and market potential 6. Approval and sanction by competent authority 7. Document Submission 8. deadlines: Calls for proposals are issued periodically and published through official channels.
implementing_agency: Kerala Startup Mission

overview: TGIIC (Telangana Industrial Infrastructure Corporation) is a Telangana Government initiative established in 2014 for providing infrastructure through development of industrial areas, including identifying and developing potential growth centers with developed plots/sheds, roads, drainage, water, power, and other infrastructural facilities, as well as social infrastructure like housing for workers near industrial zones. It also coordinates with agencies for communication, transport, and other facilities, and has active projects in Public-Private Partnership Mode. TGIIC develops Industrial Parks in all districts of Telangana and develops industrial clusters based on demand and product availability, availing Government of India grants under MSE-CDP scheme for newly developing clusters and upgradation of existing Industrial Parks.
target_beneficiaries: industrial houses; workers; agencies
eligibility: The individual will have to submit downloaded application form which was already filled in on-line duly signed by Applicant / the authorized person together with valid documents in original at the Head office/Zonal Office for land allotment.
benefits: Access to developed industrial plots/sheds with infrastructure including roads, drainage, water, power, and other facilities; social infrastructure like housing for workers near industrial zones; coordination for communication, transport and other facilities; opportunities in Public-Private Partnership Mode; presence in each Mandal Head Quarters of the District; industrial areas ranging from 15 acres to 2500 acres.
financial_support: TGIIC avails Government of India grant under MSE-CDP scheme for the newly developing clusters and up gradation of existing Industrial Parks.
application_process: 1. Submit downloaded application form which was already filled in on-line duly signed by Applicant / the authorized person 2. Together with valid documents in original at the Head office/Zonal Office 3. The Sub-committee formed with members from TGIIC, TSPCB, SFC, Commissioner of Industries, APITCO, technical consultants will scrutinize the DPR & related documents and recommend the extent of land for allotment 4. Considering these recommendations, the State Level Allotment Committee formed with the same members will approve/defer/reject the application 5. The applicant will receive the decision of the committee on the same day through his/her registered mobile.
implementing_agency: Telangana Industrial Infrastructure Corporation (TGIIC)

scheme_name: MP Laghu Udyog Nigam MSME Support
Punjab Rural Development & Panchayat Innovation Fund
overview: The Punjab Rural Development & Panchayat Innovation Fund is a state-level initiative aimed at fostering innovation and development in rural areas of Punjab through financial and technical support to panchayats and rural entrepreneurs. It focuses on promoting grassroots innovation, sustainable livelihoods, and community-driven projects. The fund supports pilot projects and scalable models that address local challenges in agriculture, sanitation, water management, and rural enterprise.
target_beneficiaries: panchayats; rural entrepreneurs; self-help groups; MSME; agri-startups
eligibility: Eligible applicants include registered panchayats, self-help groups, cooperatives, NGOs, and rural entrepreneurs operating in Punjab. Projects must be innovative, locally relevant, and demonstrate potential for scalability and sustainability. Preference is given to initiatives led by women, SC/ST communities, and those addressing climate resilience or livelihood generation.
benefits: Financial support for project implementation, technical guidance and mentorship, access to expert networks, opportunities for scaling successful pilots, and recognition under the state innovation framework. Non-financial benefits include training, monitoring and evaluation support, and facilitation of linkages with markets and government programs.
financial_support: The fund provides grants to selected projects based on project scope, innovation quotient, and implementation readiness. Financial support is disbursed in tranches linked to project milestones, with utilization monitored by the implementing agency. The exact quantum varies per project, subject to approval by the fund committee.
application_process: 1. Submit a project proposal through the designated portal or offline mode as specified. 2. Proposals are screened for eligibility and innovation potential. 3. Shortlisted applicants are invited for presentation or field verification. 4. Final selection is made by the Punjab Rural Development & Panchayat Innovation Fund Committee. 5. Approved projects receive sanction letters and begin implementation. 6. Progress is monitored through periodic reports and field visits.
implementing_agency: Department of Rural Development and Panchayats, Government of Punjab

overview: The WEBEL IT Startup Incubation Scheme is a West Bengal government initiative aimed at fostering innovation and supporting startups in the IT/ITeS/ICT/ESDM sectors by providing necessary infrastructure and ecosystem support. The scheme is implemented by the West Bengal Electronics Industry Development Corporation Limited (WEBEL), which serves as the nodal agency for promoting IT and Electronics industries in the state. It focuses on creating an investor-friendly environment and leveraging premier educational and research institutions to encourage startup growth.
target_beneficiaries: startups
eligibility: Startups working in the IT/ITeS/ICT/ESDM sector are eligible for support under the scheme, as WEBEL's mandate includes creating infrastructure support to encourage and promote such startups.
benefits: Benefits include access to state-of-the-art IT parks with modern facilities and plug-and-play rentable area, hardware parks, electronic manufacturing clusters, infrastructure support, and linkage to government initiatives for skill development, employment generation, and technology adoption.
financial_support: The scheme provides infrastructure support such as rentable space in IT parks, hardware parks, and electronic manufacturing clusters, but no direct financial grants, loans, or subsidies are mentioned in the evidence. Support is primarily in-kind through provision of physical and technical infrastructure.
application_process: The application process is not explicitly detailed in the provided evidence. Interested startups are advised to contact WEBEL directly for enrollment procedures.
implementing_agency: West Bengal Electronics Industry Development Corporation Limited (WEBEL)

scheme_name: Bihar Industrial Area Development Authority (BIADA) Scheme
JIDCO – Jharkhand Industrial Dev Corp Scheme
overview: JIDCO (Jharkhand Industrial Development Corporation) is a state-level agency under the Government of Jharkhand tasked with promoting industrial development in the state. It facilitates investment, provides infrastructure support, and assists entrepreneurs and industries in setting up and expanding operations within Jharkhand. The corporation acts as a nodal agency for various state and central government schemes aimed at boosting industrial growth and employment generation.
target_beneficiaries: industries; entrepreneurs; MSME; investors
eligibility: Eligibility criteria vary depending on the specific scheme or incentive being availed through JIDCO. Generally, applicants must be registered industrial units, entrepreneurs, or investors proposing to set up or expand operations in Jharkhand. Compliance with state industrial policies, environmental norms, and land allocation rules is required.
benefits: JIDCO provides support in land acquisition, infrastructure development, facilitation of statutory clearances, and access to financial incentives under various central and state government schemes. It acts as a single-window clearance mechanism and assists in project formulation and implementation.
financial_support: JIDCO does not directly provide financial support but facilitates access to subsidies, grants, and loans under central and state government schemes such as the Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP), Credit Guarantee Scheme, and Jharkhand State Industrial Policy incentives. The quantum and mechanism depend on the specific scheme being accessed.
application_process: 1. Identify the relevant scheme or incentive through JIDCO or state industrial policy. 2. Prepare project proposal and required documents. 3. Submit application to JIDCO either online or at its office. 4. JIDCO reviews the application for completeness and eligibility. 5. Upon approval, JIDCO facilitates land allotment, clearances, and linkage to financial incentives. 6. Monitor project implementation as per scheme guidelines.
deadlines: Rolling basis — subject to availability of funds and land under specific schemes
implementing_agency: Jharkhand Industrial Development Corporation (JIDCO), Government of Jharkhand

overview: Assam Electronic Development Corporation (AMTRON) Incubation is a state-level initiative in Assam aimed at fostering innovation and entrepreneurship by providing incubation support to startups and technology-driven ventures. The program focuses on nurturing early-stage enterprises through infrastructure, mentorship, and technical assistance. It operates under the Assam government's broader strategy to promote digital innovation and MSME growth in the region.
target_beneficiaries: startups; technology ventures; MSME
eligibility: Startups and technology-based ventures registered in Assam, particularly those working in electronics, IT, ICT, and related sectors, are eligible to apply for incubation support under AMTRON.
benefits: Incubated startups receive access to office infrastructure, internet connectivity, mentorship from industry experts, technical guidance, networking opportunities, and assistance in product development and market linkage. The program also facilitates access to funding avenues and government schemes.
financial_support: While the incubation program provides non-financial support such as infrastructure and mentorship, direct financial support like grants or seed funding is not explicitly detailed in the available evidence. Financial assistance may be facilitated through linkages with other government schemes or investors.
application_process: 1. Interested startups must visit the AMTRON official website. 2. Review the incubation program details and eligibility criteria. 3. Prepare a proposal or business plan outlining the innovation and roadmap. 4. Submit the application along with required documents via the designated channel. 5. Applications are reviewed by the AMTRON selection committee. 6. Selected startups are notified and onboarded into the incubation program.
deadlines: Rolling basis
implementing_agency: Assam Electronic Development Corporation (AMTRON)

scheme_name: HIMUDA Industrial Area Startup Plot Scheme
overview: The HIMUDA Industrial Area Startup Plot Scheme is a state-level initiative by the Himachal Pradesh Government through HIMUDA (Himachal Pradesh Urban Development Authority) to provide developed industrial plots to startups in designated industrial areas. The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship and industrial growth by offering land at concessional rates with infrastructure support. It targets early-stage ventures seeking physical space for operations within Himachal Pradesh.
target_beneficiaries: startups
eligibility: Startups registered under the Startup India initiative or recognized by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) are eligible to apply for the scheme. The applicant must be a legal entity incorporated in India and should intend to set up its operations in the industrial areas developed by HIMUDA in Himachal Pradesh.
benefits: Allotment of developed industrial plots in HIMUDA-developed industrial areas at subsidized rates. The plots come with basic infrastructure such as road connectivity, water supply, drainage, and electricity provision. Beneficiaries also get facilitation in obtaining necessary clearances and approvals for setting up their units.
financial_support: Financial support is provided in the form of subsidized land allotment where the cost of the plot is offered at a concessional rate compared to market prices. The exact quantum of subsidy or pricing details are not specified in the available evidence. There is no mention of direct grants, loans, or equity support under this scheme.
application_process: 1. Visit the official HIMUDA website or contact the concerned office to obtain application details. 2. Check eligibility and ensure DPIIT recognition or Startup India registration. 3. Submit the application form along with required documents to the HIMUDA office. 4. Application is scrutinized by the authorities. 5. If found eligible, the applicant is intimated for plot allotment. 6. Upon approval, lease agreement is signed and plot possession is handed over after payment of dues.
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline mentioned in the evidence. Applications are accepted subject to plot availability.
implementing_agency: Himachal Pradesh Urban Development Authority (HIMUDA)

scheme_name: Biswa Bangla Marketing Scheme for Handicrafts
overview: Biswa Bangla Marketing Scheme for Handicrafts is a West Bengal state-level initiative aimed at promoting and marketing traditional handicrafts, handloom, and heritage products through Biswa Bangla showrooms and warehouses across India and abroad. The scheme supports artisans and weavers by providing them a platform to sell their products via institutional procurement, tenders, and promotional orders. It operates under the Department of MSME & Textiles, Government of West Bengal, and focuses on creating market access for local crafts through e-tendering and direct sales channels.
target_beneficiaries: artisans; weavers; MSME; self-help groups; handicraft manufacturers; handloom producers
geographic_scope: West Bengal (with national and international market access)
eligibility: Artisans, weavers, self-help groups (SHGs), clusters, co-operative societies, and MSMEs registered in West Bengal engaged in handicrafts, handloom, or heritage product manufacturing are eligible to participate. They must be capable of supplying products as per approved specifications and may need to meet turnover, experience, and documentation criteria depending on the specific tender or promotional order.
benefits: Beneficiaries gain access to institutional buyers, government procurement opportunities, promotional orders, and direct sales through Biswa Bangla showrooms. They receive support in product listing, quality compliance, and market linkage. Selected vendors may get work orders based on L1 rates, with provisions for MSE price preference and performance-based allocation. Payments are made upon delivery and verification, with performance security refunds where applicable.
financial_support: Financial support is provided through work orders and promotional orders issued after e-tendering. Payments are made per unit at the L1 (lowest) rate discovered through bidding, inclusive of GST and delivery charges. For promotional orders, MSE units may receive up to 20% of total quantity. Performance security (typically 3-10% of order value) is required and refunded upon successful completion. No upfront grants or subsidies are provided; compensation is strictly against delivered goods/services.
application_process: 1. Identify relevant tender or promotional order notice on https://wbtenders.gov.in or https://biswabangla.in. 2. Register and obtain Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) for e-tendering. 3. Download tender documents from the e-procurement portal. 4. Prepare technical bid with required documents (e.g., audited financials, GST, PAN, experience certificates). 5. Prepare financial bid (BOQ) quoting rates per unit. 6. Submit both bids simultaneously on https://wbtenders.gov.in before the deadline. 7. Attend pre-bid meeting if scheduled. 8. Await technical evaluation; only qualified bidders proceed to financial bid opening. 9. L1 bidder is selected based on lowest rate; work order issued. 10. Supply goods as per schedule and specifications. 11. Submit invoice and performance security. 12. Receive payment after verification and deductibles.
deadlines: Varies per tender; typically bid submission closes 3-4 weeks after notice publication. Promotional orders have fixed last dates (e.g., 7 October 2025 for school bags). Some tenders allow rolling basis or extensions via corrigendum.
implementing_agency: Biswa Bangla Marketing Corporation Limited, under Department of MSME & Textiles, Government of West Bengal

overview: The J&K Handicrafts Development Corporation Scheme is a state-level initiative aimed at promoting and developing the handicrafts sector in Jammu and Kashmir. It focuses on supporting artisans and handicraft units through financial assistance, infrastructure development, and market linkages. The scheme seeks to preserve traditional crafts, enhance productivity, and improve the socio-economic conditions of artisans in the region.
target_beneficiaries: artisans; handicraft units; MSME
eligibility: Artisans, handicraft units, cooperatives, and MSMEs engaged in handicraft activities in Jammu and Kashmir are eligible to apply under the scheme. Beneficiaries must be registered with the concerned authorities and possess valid identification and business documents.
benefits: Financial assistance for setting up new units, modernization of existing units, raw material procurement, marketing support, participation in exhibitions, infrastructure development, skill training, and design development support. Subsidies are provided on capital expenditure and working capital requirements.
financial_support: The scheme provides financial support in the form of subsidies ranging from 20% to 50% of the project cost, depending on the category of beneficiary and nature of activity. Assistance is disbursed through the J&K Handicrafts Development Corporation after project appraisal and approval. The support covers capital investment, working capital, and infrastructure development.
application_process: 1. Submit application form to the J&K Handicrafts Development Corporation. 2. Attach required documents including project report, registration certificates, and identity proof. 3. Application undergoes scrutiny and field verification. 4. Approved projects are sanctioned financial assistance. 5. Funds are released in installments based on project progress and utilization certificates.
deadlines: Rolling basis
implementing_agency: J&K Handicrafts Development Corporation

scheme_name: Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council – Startup Fund
Goa Investment Promotion Board MSME Scheme
overview: The Goa Investment Promotion Board (GIPB) MSME Scheme is a state-level initiative aimed at promoting micro, small, and medium enterprises in Goa by providing financial incentives and support for investment in eligible sectors. The scheme focuses on encouraging new investments, technology upgradation, and employment generation within the state. It offers subsidies on capital expenditure and interest to qualifying MSME units.
target_beneficiaries: MSME
eligibility: MSME units registered with the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce, Government of Goa, engaged in manufacturing or service activities, having made eligible investments in plant and machinery or equipment, and complying with environmental and other regulatory norms as applicable.
benefits: Eligible MSME units receive capital investment subsidy on plant and machinery, interest subsidy on term loans, and reimbursement of expenses for ISO certification, patent registration, and barcode acquisition. Additional support includes assistance for quality improvement, technology adoption, and market development.
financial_support: The scheme provides a capital investment subsidy of up to 30% on eligible investment in plant and machinery, subject to a ceiling of INR 20 lakhs per unit. Interest subsidy is offered at 5% per annum on term loans for a period of 5 years. Reimbursement for ISO certification, patent registration, and barcode is available up to 50% of actual costs, capped at INR 50,000 per activity.
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to INR 20 lakhs for capital investment subsidy
application_process: 1. Submit application form along with required documents to the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce, Goa. 2. Application is scrutinized for eligibility and completeness. 3. Site verification may be conducted by officials. 4. Approved applications are forwarded to the Goa Investment Promotion Board for sanction. 5. Upon approval, subsidy amount is disbursed after verification of investment and operational commencement.
deadlines: Rolling basis
implementing_agency: Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce, Government of Goa

overview: The OCAC IT Startup Incubation Scheme is a state-level initiative by the Odisha Computer Application Centre (OCAC) under the Electronics & IT Department, Government of Odisha, aimed at fostering innovation and supporting early-stage IT startups through incubation services. The scheme provides infrastructure, mentorship, technical support, and access to government resources to help startups develop scalable solutions. It aligns with Odisha's broader vision to become a digital economy hub by nurturing local talent and promoting entrepreneurship in the IT, ITeS, and ESDM sectors.
target_beneficiaries: startups; IT startups; entrepreneurs
eligibility: Startups must be registered entities (Private Limited Company, LLP, or Partnership) incorporated in Odisha, working on innovative IT/ITeS/ESDM solutions, with a focus on technology-driven products or services. Preference may be given to startups aligned with state priorities such as AI, fintech, semiconductors, and digital governance.
benefits: Incubation support includes access to office infrastructure, high-speed internet, mentorship from industry experts, technical guidance on product development, assistance in accessing government schemes and funding, networking opportunities with investors and academia, and support for prototyping, testing, and market linkage. Startups also get facilitation in availing incentives under Odisha Electronics Component Manufacturing Policy 2025 and other state IT policies.
financial_support: The scheme does not provide direct financial grants or seed funding. Instead, it offers non-financial support such as infrastructure, mentorship, and facilitation to access external funding sources. Financial support, if any, would be linked to central or state startup schemes like Startup Odisha or SISFS, but no specific quantum is mentioned in the evidence.
application_process: 1. Visit the OCAC website or designated portal for startup incubation. 2. Submit an online application with details of the startup, team, idea, and stage of development. 3. Attach required documents including incorporation proof, PAN, pitch deck, and team profiles. 4. Application is reviewed by OCAC's selection committee based on innovation, feasibility, and alignment with state goals. 5. Shortlisted startups are invited for interview or pitch presentation. 6. Selected startups are onboarded into the incubation program with access to resources and mentorship.
deadlines: Rolling basis
implementing_agency: Odisha Computer Application Centre (OCAC), under the Electronics & Information Technology Department, Government of Odisha

overview: Haryana Textile Policy 2019 is a state-level policy aimed at promoting the textile industry in Haryana by providing fiscal incentives, infrastructure support, and market access to textile enterprises. It focuses on enhancing competitiveness on cluster development, technology upgradation, and employment generation in the textile sector. The policy aligns with national initiatives like Make in India and focuses on both traditional and thrust textile clusters in the state.
target_beneficiaries: MSME; textile enterprises; entrepreneurs
eligibility: Eligibility is based on the provisions of Haryana Enterprise Promotion Policy (EPP) 2015, which includes MSMEs and enterprises in thrust sectors like textiles, with specific categorization of development blocks (A, B, C, D) and focus on geographically dispersed growth, cluster approach, market linkages, infrastructure strengthening, technology adoption, entrepreneurship promotion, credit flow enhancement, sickness prevention, incubation centers, and capacity building.
benefits: Benefits include fiscal incentives as per Haryana Enterprise Promotion Policy 2015, cluster development support, market linkage facilitation, infrastructure strengthening, technology access and upgradation, entrepreneurship and skill development programs, enhanced credit flow, sick unit revival support, institutional strengthening, and capacity building for textile enterprises in Haryana.
financial_support: Financial support is provided through fiscal incentives under the Haryana Enterprise Promotion Policy 2015, including subsidies, interest benefits, and capital subsidies for eligible textile enterprises, with specific schemes for cluster development, infrastructure, technology upgradation, and employment generation, though exact quantum and mechanism are not detailed in the evidence.
application_process: The application process is not explicitly detailed in the evidence; however, incentives and concessions are available to those eligible as per the provisions of Haryana Enterprise Promotion Policy (EPP) 2015, which likely involves submission through District Industries Centres (DICs) or the Haryana Enterprises Promotion Centre (HEPC) portal.
implementing_agency: Department of Industries & Commerce, Haryana
contact_details: Email: acsindustriesharyana1[at]gmail[dot]com, director-msme[at]hry[dot]gov[dot]in, info-msme@hry.gov.in | Phone: 0172-2741208 (Additional Chief Secretary), 0172-2701344 (Director General Industries & Commerce), 0172-2580710 (Director General MSME), 0172-2580707 (Directorate of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises)

scheme_name: CIPET – Central Institute of Petrochemicals Engineering CG Scheme
overview: CIPET – Central Institute of Petrochemicals Engineering & Technology is a premier autonomous institution under the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, Government of India, established in 1968 with UNDP assistance. It provides academic programs, skill development training, technology support, and research & development services for the petrochemicals and plastics industries across India. The institute operates through multiple centres including IPT, CSTS, and SARP, offering diploma, undergraduate, postgraduate, and Ph.D. programs in various engineering and technology disciplines.
target_beneficiaries: students; entrepreneurs; MSME; industries; researchers
eligibility: Eligibility varies by program: For Diploma in Plastics Technology (DPT) and Diploma in Plastics Mould Technology (DPMT): Full time 10th Std. For Post Graduate Diploma in Plastics Processing & Testing (PGD-PPT): Full time 3-year Degree in Science. For Post Diploma in Plastics Mould Design with CAD/CAM: 3 year full time Diploma in Mechanical / Plastics / Polymer / Tool / Production / Mechatronics / Automobile / Tool & Die Making / Petrochemicals / Industrial / Instrumentation Engg / Technology or DPMT/DPT or Equivalent. For UG/PG Degree programs: As per norms set out by respective affiliated State Universities. No age bar for most programs.
benefits: Academic programs affiliated to State Universities, AICTE-approved engineering programs, scholarships for meritorious students (Rs.8,000–12,000 per semester based on rank), hostel facilities, placement support (80% placement rate), technology support services including testing, standardization, machinery selection, tool room setup, and technical consultancy, research opportunities at SARP centres, skill development training programs approved by NCVET, and access to industry linkages and placement networks.
financial_support: Scholarships are granted to meritorious students pursuing Diploma/Post Diploma/Post Graduate Diploma programmes. The scholarship amount is Rs.12,000/- per candidate for All India 1st Rank Holder, Rs.10,000/- per candidate for All India 2nd Rank Holder, and Rs.8,000/- per candidate for All India 3rd Rank Holder per semester based on previous semester results. The scheme targets students from three-year Diploma programmes, two-year Post Graduate Diploma, and 1.5-year Post Diploma programmes. A total of 30 candidates per semester are selected. Scholarship is disbursed directly to the CIPET Centre where the student is pursuing the programme from the interest amount earned from the fund donated by Plast India Foundation.
grant_amount_per_entity: Rs.12,000/- per candidate for All India 1st Rank Holder, Rs.10,000/- per candidate for All India 2nd Rank Holder, and Rs.8,000/- per candidate for All India 3rd Rank Holder per Semester
application_process: 1. CIPET releases admission notice in leading English and regional newspapers in February/March every year. 2. Candidates can register application through the online admission portal linked to CIPET website (www.cipet.gov.in) against payment as notified. 3. Applications can be submitted online till the last date as notified in the admission notice. 4. Admission is conducted through a CAT – Online CIPET Admission Test conducted at selected places on all India basis, likely on a Sunday in May/June/July every year. 5. Selection is based on eligibility criteria set by affiliated State Universities for UG/PG programs and as per CIPET norms for diploma programs. 6. Category-wise reservation is followed: Scheduled Caste 15%, Scheduled Tribe 7.5%, Other Backward Classes + Minority 27%, Physically Challenged 3% (horizontal), General & Others 37.5%, Economically weaker section 10%. 7. Provisional selection is cancelled if candidate does not accept the allotment within stipulated time, and wait list is operated to fill vacancies.
deadlines: Admission notice released in February/March every year. Online CAT – CIPET Admission Test likely conducted on a Sunday in May/June/July every year. Exact dates announced through website or newspaper.
implementing_agency: Department of Chemicals & Petrochemicals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, Government of India
contact_details: Email: academics@cipet.gov.in | Telephone No.: 044-2225 4780 / 22254514 | Head Office: Central Institute of Petrochemicals Engineering & Technology, Academic Cell, Head Office, Guindy, Chennai - 600 032.

overview: The Rajasthan Agro Processing Startup Scheme is a state-level initiative aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and innovation in the agro-processing sector within Rajasthan. It supports startups engaged in value addition, processing, and preservation of agricultural produce through financial and non-financial assistance. The scheme seeks to enhance rural employment, reduce post-harvest losses, and strengthen the agro-value chain by encouraging technology-driven solutions. It aligns with the state's vision to position Rajasthan as a hub for agro-processing startups.
target_beneficiaries: agri-startups; startups; MSME
eligibility: Startups registered in Rajasthan engaged in agro-processing activities such as grading, sorting, packaging, preservation, or value addition of agricultural produce. The entity must be recognized by DPIIT or registered under the Startup India initiative. Preference is given to ventures led by women, SC/ST, or differently abled entrepreneurs. The startup should have a viable business model with potential for scalability and job creation.
benefits: Financial support in the form of grants or seed funding, mentorship and incubation support, access to testing and certification facilities, assistance in market linkage and branding, facilitation of regulatory approvals, and networking opportunities with investors and industry experts. Additional benefits include priority in government procurement, access to shared infrastructure, and technical guidance on food safety standards.
financial_support: The scheme provides financial assistance up to INR 25 lakhs per eligible startup as a grant for capital expenditure, working capital, or technology acquisition. The support is disbursed in tranches based on milestone achievement and utilization verification. There is no equity dilution or repayment obligation under this grant-based mechanism.
grant_amount_per_entity: INR 25 lakhs
application_process: 1. Visit the official Rajasthan State Scheme Dashboard or Jan Soochna Portal. 2. Navigate to the 'Rajasthan Agro Processing Startup Scheme' under the Agriculture or Industries department. 3. Click on 'Apply Now' and register using Jan Aadhaar or SSO ID. 4. Fill in the application form with details of the startup, business model, and projected impact. 5. Upload required documents including incorporation certificate, DPIIT recognition, PAN, and project report. 6. Submit the application and await scrutiny by the nodal agency. 7. Shortlisted applicants may be called for presentation or interview. 8. Upon approval, the grant is disbursed in phases as per milestones.
deadlines: Rolling basis
implementing_agency: Department of Agriculture, Government of Rajasthan

scheme_name: Centre of Excellence for Climate & Sustainability (CoECS)
overview: The Centre of Excellence for Climate & Sustainability (CoECS) is a scheme under the Department of Science & Technology (DST) aimed at fostering research, development, and innovation in climate and sustainability technologies. It supports deep-tech initiatives through financial mechanisms like long-term loans, equity infusion, and contributions to Deep-Tech Fund of Funds, targeting transformative R&D projects at Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) 4 and above. The scheme is implemented via Special Purpose Funds (SPF) under the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) and involves Second-Level Fund Managers (SLFMs) such as AIFs, DFIs, NBFCs, and FROs. It aligns with national goals of technological self-reliance and Atmanirbhar Bharat.
target_beneficiaries: startups; MSME; industry players; research institutions
eligibility: Eligible Technology Entities: means any legal entity which is engaged in developing RDI-intensive technology (TRL4 and above). It targets startups, MSMEs, and research entities working on innovative power sector solutions. The initiative aligns with national goals of energy transition, self-reliance, and ease of doing business in the power sector.
target_beneficiaries: startups; MSME; research institutions; startups in power sector

benefits: Financial grants for prototype development, pilot projects, and technology validation. Access to Ministry of Power’s network of CPSUs, utilities, and technical experts for pilot testing and validation. Mentorship and technical guidance from domain experts in the power sector. Assistance in regulatory approvals and standards compliance. Opportunities for pilot projects with state utilities and CPSUs. Visibility through Ministry of Power platforms and events.
financial_support: Financial support is provided as grants for prototype development, pilot projects, and technology validation. The grant amount is determined based on project scope and stage of innovation, with disbursement linked to project milestones. Funds are disbursed in tranches upon achievement of predefined milestones and submission of utilization certificates.
application_process: 1. Visit the Ministry of Power’s offerings page at https://powermin.gov.in/offerings. 2. Navigate to the POWER-Tech India – Power Sector Innovation Grants scheme details. 3.
